320: Uvegin kach yiflach li. amar nakva secharcha, ha nekeva deihu secharcha kad bekadmita. veettena, ema man nekeva istakkalt bah, veettena, ufelach li beginah.

(Sham) vayyomer yaakov lo titten li meuma, amar yaakov chalila, deha ana kol ma deavidna, leshem yekara demalka kaddisha avidna, (sefer acher velav lechissufa dagerameay) veal da lo titten li meuma, deha lav datay behay, ella im taase li (et) haddavar hazze vegomer.

(Sham) vayyasar bayyom hahu et hatteyashim. ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Tehillim 15:1) Adonai mi yagur beoholecha vegomer, ha okimna, veukemuha chavrayay, (sham) holech tamim, da avraham, dechad itgezar tamim ikre. ufoel tzedek, da yitzchak. vedover emet, da yaakov. vadday yaakov beemet itdabbak, i hu beemet itdabbak, may taama avad im lavan kegavvna da.

Ela, yaakov bachin shata demazzeleh hava. deshare leh leenash, lemivchan shateh, ad la yatuv leareh, vei mazzaleh kaim bemma deavid shappir, vei lav la yoshit ragloy ad deyislak (sefer acher dekaim bema deavid) legabbeh.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Bereshit 30:33) veanta bi tzidkati beyom machar vegomer, deha ihu la avad begin deyittol middileh lemaggana, ella kolla bekusheta ushelimu diruta, vela od ella deihu natil reshu millavan, veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 30:27) nichashti vayvaracheni Adonai biglalecha. kamma chorashin vezinin avad lavan, uvachin mazzaleh begineh deyaakov, vehava ashkach begineh deyaakov, mea ana kol yarcha, umea imrin umea izzin yattir al aneh.

Rabbi abba amar, elef anin, veelef imrin, veelef izzin, hava mayyte leh yaakov yattir bechol yarcha veyarcha. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 30:30) ki meat asher haya lecha lefanay vayyifrotz larov vayvarech Adonai otcha leragli, uvircheta dilela lav ihu pachot meelef mikkol zina vezina, meanin elef ishtakkach, meimrin elef ishtakkach, meizzin elef ishtakkach. al kol ma desharya bircheta dilela, la pachot meelef. ad divgineh deyaakov istallak lavan lechamma utera.

Vechad vaa yaakov lenatleh agreh, la ashkach ella asara mikkol zina vezina, veyaakov chashiv leh leutera saggi. chame kamma natil middileh, mimma dehava yahiv ihu bizchuteh lelavan. vechol da desalik beh yaakov, la hava ella bizroa deinun maklot, deshavve legabbe ana.

Ta chaze, kamma tarach hahu shelema deyaakov, avatreh delavan. ketiv, (Bereshit 30) vayyasem derech sheloshet yamim vegomer, vehava ayyte leh kol hay utera. veim kol da, la vaa lavan dihe agreh deyaakov hachi, ella netal asara min da vaasara min da veyahav (bida divne) leh. veamar leh tol hanne. vei yolidu kema daamart, behay gavvna yehe agrach. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 30) vattachlef et maskureti aseret monim, (uvehane) asara min da vaasara min da, uchetiv, (Bereshit 30) vaavichen hetel bi vehechelif et maskureti aseret monim. (uvehane esre) ishtaddal batar kudesha berich hu, uvarcheh. umikkol ma deshavve lavan immeh deyaakov, ahadar bemilluleh, venatil miyyaakov kolla, ad dekudesha berich hu chas aleh, venatal middileh bizroa.

Amar ribbi elazar kol hanne kerae, leachazaa chachmata ka atyayn. detaninan millin dilela, minnehon talyayn beovada, uminhon bemillula uminnehon biruta delibba. uman devae leamshacha birchan, bitzlota, bemillula, ureuta. uminnehon dela bitzlota, ella beovada talyayn.

Ta chaze, yaakov shelim, kol ma deavad, bechachmeta avid, ketiv (bareasheytel) vayyatztzeg et hammaklot asher pitztzel barhatim beshikkatot hammayim, kolla bechachmeta, leamshacha birchan mimmabbua decholla, lechullehu dargin illain deinun chulakeh veadveh.

Et hammaklot. man maklot, illen dargin deinun be dina. asher pitztzel, deaavar minnehon dina. barhatim, hayeynu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:6) melech asur barhatim, deha mehahu melech, atyayn birchan lechullehu almin.
321: Melech asur barhatim, melech da, asur vekashur beinun rehatin illain, deminnayyhu ishtakyayn kolla, (nusach acher itmashshechan birchan lakevalea) mimmelech illaa. beshikkatot hammayim, (sefer acher umittamman ishtakyayn kolla shekatot hammayim), illen inun nachalin denafkin veatyayn, ad dematu leatar demitkanshe tamman. asher tavona hatztzon lishtot, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:11) yashku kol chayto saday yishberu feraim tzemaam. uvehahu atar, demitkanshe tamman maya, kullehu atyayn leashkaa minneh.

(Bereshit 30) vayyechamna, may vayyechamna. ta chaze, beshata deruach tzafon nashiv, mayin gelidin vela nagdin levar vela ishtakyayn, begin dedina talya, ukeriru detzafon galid maya. vechad itar ruach darom, mitchamme maya, veitavar gelidu dilhon venagdin, keden itshakyayn kolla. begin dechamimu dedarom sharan maya, vechullehu mitchamme vechadan lemishte mehahu keriru detzafon, dehava lon bekadmita, hada hu dichtiv vayyechamna. vayyechamna, veha (velo) ketiv vayyechemu. ella deinun kullehu nukeve.

Veal da itkavvavn yaakov, lemebad ovada bechachmeta, veda hu dichtiv (Bereshit 30:37) vayyikkach lo yaakov makal livne lach vegomer. patach (nusach acher rabbi elazar) veamar (Tehillim 135:4) ki yaakov bachar lo yah yisrael lisgullato, ta chaze ki yaakov bachar lo yah, ad kan la yadana man barir leman, i kudesha berich hu barir leh leyaakov, i yaakov barir leh lekudesha berich hu. ella mimma degale kera, yadana dekudesha berich hu natil leh leyaakov leadveh, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.

Ta chaze, hachi name yaakov, birer achsanteh veadveh lechulakeh, vesalik leela mikkol dargin, venatil leh leadveh. makkal livne lach, hayeynu darga chivvavra distar yemina. veluz vearmon, hayeynu darga sumeka distar semala.

Vayfatztzel bahen petzalot levanot, deaavar dina min da, veitchabbar leh bimina, vehu al benayyhu venatil lon kechada veitavid kolla chad bitri gavvne. veim kol da, machsof hallavan, deyitgalle chivvavra al sumeka. vechol da lemay, leamshacha ledarga da deadveh birchan mimmabbua decholla (nusach acher denachala), uleshavvaa ledarga da deihu telata kechada.

Barhatim beshikkatot hammayim, kema deokimna. ucheden beovada da dechachmeta nagdin birchan letatta, umitshakyayn (nusach acher umitbarchan) kullehu almin vesharyayn aleh birchan, kema deukemuha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:27) babboker ychal ad vegomer, ulevatar mikkan, (sham) velaerev yechallek shalal,
322: Leitbarcha kullehu almin letatta. veyaakov natal chulakeh, meinun birchan, desharyayn aleh letatta, begin deihu chulakeh veadva dekudesha berich hu.

Sitre tora (Bereshit 30:37) vayyikkach lo yaakov makkal livne vegomer, mattenittin, reutta deovada, kitre dimhemnutta, kal kala dekalya ittear meela letatta, anan petichin ayynin havinan. galgela aschar meela lechamma sitrin, kal neimutta ittear. ittearu nayymin demichin deshinta bechorehon, vela yade vela mistakkelan, vela chaman. atimin udenin, kevedin delibba, nayymin vela yadin. orayyta kayyma kammayyhu, vela mashgichin vela yade bemma mistakkelan, chaman vela chaman. orayyta ramatt kalin istekalu tippeshin, pittechu ayynin, vtindeun. lett man deyishgach, velett man deyarchin udeneh, ad ma tehevun bego choshocha diruttayychu. istakkalu leminda, veittegli lechon nehora denohir.

Bezimna deyaakov shelema, miggo aku deara ureshu ochora, bego dargin nucherain dacha lechullehu, uvarir chulak adveh veachsanteh. nehora miggo chashocha, chachmeta miggo tippeshutta, veokir leh lemareh kad hava kaim bego reshutta del zar. al da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 29:22) lo atta yevosh yaakov velo atta panav yechevru.

Tosefta kutera dekutera dachya, hava salik lego lego, ad la ashkach attar bett mottava. hahu attar lav attar, lav ishtakkach leela vtatta. mikkolla itteavid, avaddon havi mikkolla, avaddon dechura, 131 denappak mehittucha detukepa deyitztzechak. avaddon umavt nukeva dileh, nachash kadmaa, eshett zenunim, dichtiv (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai) ragleha yordott mavt. villen teren, avaddon umavt, shemau tukepa dehuremanu demalka.

Raza vsittera setima (nusach acher temira) illaa itteavid (nusach acher tamir) mikkolla, itteavid (nusach acher tamir) meraayonin (nusach acher maayynayn) vhirhurin. (sefer acher man deitmeshach batar illen itavid mikkolla. kola behippucha da min da tabevahey digvar shelim keyaakov desalik velo itchashshachu ayynin behay tenana vezacha leitkerava beemet chotama demalka kaddisha. ta chaze, temira illaa mikkolla) minneh nappak att 10, nekuda illaa. mehay nekuda illaa nappak kolla. amshicha vappik Adonai, imma illaa deashke lecholla. mehay noppik 6, raza deshitt deachid lechol sitrin, deihu, makkal livne lach, vlott, vearmon.

Teren deroin deachidan beh, illen nappeke vachidu beHei tattaa, lechabbera mashkena kechad ulemehevi chad. keden, telesar mechilan havu chad. vchivvavra itteglif al gevavnin vsalik al gavvavn kullehu. hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 30:37) machsof hallavan, ucheden ikre (Zecharya 14:9) Adonai echad ushemo echad. ucheden (Tehillim 23:2) Adonai roi lo echsar. uchetiv binott deshe yarbitztzeni al me menuchott yenahaleni nappeshi yeshovev vegomer. (ad kan tosefta)

Vayyikkach lo yaakov, (Bereshit 30:37) barir leh lechulakeh laadabeyh, makkel levana lach, sitra dimina, gon chivvavr. lach, sitra ihu damim. veluz, da sitra dismala, sumeka kavevaredaa. vearmon, kalil da beda. vechullehu achid yemina chivvavra bagevavenayh, vesalleka behu. dichtiv machsof hallavan, deaf al gav deachid litren sitrin, natal (sefer acher nata) chulakeh listar yemina, vaagaleyf becholla, behay sitra uvehay sitra, keden ikre gevar shelim, shelim becholla.

Ma ketiv batreh, (sham) vehaya bechol yecham hatztzon hamekushsharot vesham yaakov et hammaklot vegomer. sitra desitterin, lechakkime lavo itmesar. bego mashshiryayn illain kaddishin it dargin illain illen al illen, illen penimain, veillen levar. inun penimain matekasherayn bemalka kaddisha, umitkashsherin beyisrael, benin kaddishin lekaddesha berich hu, veillen ikrun hatztzon hamekushsharot, mashshiryayn deinnun makesharevat, ella vetatta.

Beshaata detiuveta dilhon legabbe zaveharea illaa dilella. ammuda deemtzaita, yaakov shelema natal inun maklot, tefillin deresha, barhatim, atar veducheta, ladeyveray tefillin. umehacha natle nehora vazeyvevaa, kol chelin umashshiryayn illain, inun dametakesharen leella vametakesharen letatta. kevan deinnun natlin miggo rahatin shekatot hammayim, keden, inun havo mekorin umabbuin lenachta letatta ulemehav lecholla.

Uvegin kach, aperaysh yaakov ben dargin illain kaddishin, ledargin acharanin, dishar ammin. kema deat amar, (Bereshit 30:40) vayyesht lo adarim levaddo velo satam al tzon lavan. (inun) adarim aperaysh leh

Ribbi yesa zuta hava shechiach kammeh deribbi shimon, amar leh. hay dichtiv (Mishlei 10:6) berachot lerosh tzaddik, latzaddik mibbae leh, may lerosh tzaddik. amar leh, rosh tzaddik da hi atara kaddisha, veukemuha. tu, rosh tzaddik, da yaakov, deihu natil birchan, venagid lon latzaddik, umittamman izderiku lechol evar, umitbarchan kullehu almin.

Aval ha okimna, berachot lerosh tzaddik, (rosh) tzaddik ikre, hahu atar (sefer acher 33 resha) divrit, deminneh nafkin mabbuin levar, nukeva dekista dechamra nafik minneh, ihu resha. kach rosh tzaddik, hahu atar, kad zarik mabbuin lenukeva, ikre rosh tzaddik. tzaddik ihu rosh (nusach acher resha lechol birchan) begin dechol birchan beh sharyayn.

Tu, hahu bar nash, dezache lemintar at kayyayma kaddisha, veavid pikkude deorayyta, tzaddik ikre, umerisheh vead ragloy hachi ikre. vechad birchan nagdin lealma, sharyayn al resheh, uminneh kayyme birchan lealma, bivnin kaddishin zakkain deokim.

Ribbi yesa tu shail veamar, (Tehillim 37:25) ketiv naar hayiti gam zakanti vegomer. hay kera ukemuha desaro dealma amaro, ihu amaro bechachmeta, yattir mimma dechashvin bene nasha. amar leh, beri yaot hu, deha beyichuda kaddisha ittemar naar hayiti gam zakanti vehachi hu.
(Tehillim 37:25) velo raiti tzaddik neezav, da hu shevacha deyichuda, dela ishtakkach yom bela layla. deha layla beh ishtakkach tedira, vetzaddik achid leela veachid letatta.

Vezaro mevakkesh lachem, may hu. ella, beshata dezarik veitnegid zara, la tava lenukeva. deha bahadeh sharya, dela itparsha minneh lealmin, vezammina hi legabbeh. deha zara la nagid, ella beshata denukeva zemina,
323: Legarmeh, dela yehe leh cholek bishar ammin, kema deafrish leh, darge dimhemnuta leella, lechulakeh veadveh, hachi itzterich leafrasha dargin demashreyayn kaddishin letatta, lekashshera lon bahadeh, beinnun hechalin dematronita.

Vechullehu reshimin, birshimu demalka illaa. kema deyisrael, reshimin letatta, ben kol shear ammin, uf dargin demashreyayn illain, reshimin inun lechulakeh (dekudesha) lekudesha berich hu, ben kol shear chelin, umashshiryayn illain. veal da barir yaakov inun lechulakeh veadveh, reshimin lachevalekaa (beraza) dimhemnuta, (sefer acher uvegin kach ketiv ki yaakov bachar lo yah yisrael lisgullato yah illaa ihu barir chulakeh veadveh raza dimhemnuta) uf hachi kudsha berich hu, barir leh, mikkol shear chelin umashshiryayn dealma.

Umashshiryayn illain, mitparshan illen meillen. beshaata dezihara denura binhiru dishchinta itgalya, kol inun dargin acharanin, atekasepan, vametaatapey mehahu zahara velo yachlu lekarva legabbeh. vechol inun tikkunin (sefer acher dargin) kaddishin, deinnun tikkuna dileh. beshaata deitgalya hahu zahara, miyyad chaddan vaselaken leitkerava bahadeh, uleitkeshshera legabbeh, veihu behu ittaknat, (ittakkan) vesittera da (Bereshit 30:42) vehayu haatufim lelavan vahekashevareym leyaakov.

Veitzterich levarra (sefer acher levarcha) uleitparasha dargin kaddishin (sefer acher lechulakeh) dechulakeh. meinnun dargin dishar ammin, uvecholla itzterich yaakov kaddisha (sefer acher buchera dekudsha berich hu leitkerava) veal da kudsha berich hu ketiv beorayyta, mehemanuta dileh, bego sitre (sefer acher sitre) millin illen. zakkaa chulakeh.
Vetiuveta detarvavyyhu kechada bedibbuka chad dela mitparshan, veal da la itzterich lemitba alah.
Amar leh, uvezimna degaluta lav hachi. amar leh zaro ketiv, velav ihu. ematay nafik, kad nukeva bedibbuka chad im dechura. vei tema la raiti tzaddik neezav, bezimna degaluta may hi.

Ella, ha achid leela. vela neezav lealmin, bezimna ochora, lo neezav minnukeva, achid leela, veachid letatta. achid leela, bezimna degaluta. bezimna ochora, achid litren sitrin, leela vetatta, uleolam eno neezav.
Ketiv, (Bereshit 1:17) vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim, da tzaddik. veaf al gav deittemar birkia hashshamayim, ella birkia hashshamayim vadday, deihu siyyuma degufa.

Ta chaze, terin rekiin inun, veinun sheruta vesiyyuma, da kegavvna da. sheruta rekia teminaa, beh shekian kol kochvaya, zeirin veravrevin. veda hu rekia illaa setimaa, dekaim kolla uminneh nafik kolla. veihu teminaa, mittatta leela, vehu sheruta leafaka minneh kolla.

Kacha ihu rekia teminaa meela letatta, deveh shekiin kol kochvaya, kol nehorin uvotzinin. vehu natil kolla veda siyyuma decholla. kema dehahu rekia teminaa, deihu sheruta decholla. talyayn beh kol nehorin venatil lon, uminneh nafke. hachi name hay, ihu rekia teminaa, talyayn beh kol nehorin venatil lon, uminneh nafku lechullehu almin.

Sheruta vesiyyuma kegavvna chad kayyme, veal da ihu nahar denagid venafik, vela paske memoy lealmin. kolla lemehve siyyuma kesheruta, uvegin kach vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim, velamma, lehair al haaretz.

Veaf al gav deittemar kolla kegavvna chada kayyme, veda hu berira demilla, ma ben hay lehay. ella, da okim vezan lealma illaa deihu beh ulechol inun sitrin illain, veda okim vezan lealma tattaa ulechol inun sitrin tattain.

Vei tema, alma dilela man ihu, veha (ihu) hahu rekia teminaa illaa setimaa, alma dilela ihu vehachi ikre, deha teren almin ninhu kema deittemar. ella, ihu alma illaa, vechol inun denafke minneh, al shemeh ikrun. veinun denafke mealma tattaa, al shemeh ikrun. vechol hay vehay kolla chad, berich hu lealam ulealme almin.

Ta chaze (Tehillim 104:16) yisbeu atze Adonai arze levanon asher nata. man levanon. ha ukemuha veittemar, hay kera (Tehillim 104:16) asher sham tzipporim yekannenu chasida beroshim betah. asher sham tzipporim yekannenu, bean atar, ballevanon. veillen inun teren tzipporim dekaamaran bechamma atar,
324: Umeillen itparshan kamma tzipporin ochoranin, aval illen illain venafkin millevanon deihu (sefer acher setimaa) leela, veraza demilla, (Bereshit 29:16) ulelavan shete vanot vegomer.

Chasida beroshim betah, (sefer acher da lea) beinun shit benin illain, shit sitrin dealma, kema deittemar. ammay ikre chasida. ella, hay alma illaa af al gav denukeva ihi, karinan lah dachar, dechad itpashshat, kol tivu vechol nehiru minneh nafik.

Uvegin kach deihi chasida, nafik (mittamman) minah chesed, deihu nehora kadmaa, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:3) vayyomer elohim yehi or. veal da beroshim betah. beroshim, al tikre beroshim, ella berashim. deha alma ochora, betattain betah, veihi be dina dealma. ulezimnin ikre kegavvna dilela, bechol inun shemahan.

Veal atar da ketiv, (Bereshit 6:6) vayyinnachem Adonai vayyitatztzev el libbo. charon af Adonai. deha beatar da talya. deha kol ma dilela, kolla ihu binhiru, chayyin lechol sitrin. veal da taninan, en atzvut lifne hammakom, lifne dayyka. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha bou lefanav birnana. ivdu et Adonai besimcha, lokovel alma illaa, bou lefanav birnana lokovel alma tattaa. zakkain inun yisrael bealma den uvealma deate. begin kach ketiv, (Devarim 33:29) ashrecha yisrael mi chamocha am nosha baAdonai magen ezrecha vaasher cherev gaavatecha veyikkachashu vegomer.

(Bereshit 30:38) vayyatztzeg et hammaklot asher pitztzel barhatim vegomer. patach rabbi elazar veamar, (Mishlei 9:12) im chachamta chachamta lach velatzta levaddecha tisa. im chachamta chachamta lach, ta chaze, vavy leinun chayyayve alma, dela yadin vela mashgichin bemille deorayyta. vechad inun mashgichin bah, begin delet lon suchletanu, millin deorayyta damyayn beenayyhu keillu kullehu male rekanya, velet behu toalta. vecholla begin deinun rekanin middata vesuchletanu. deha kol mile deorayyta, kullehu millin illain veyakkirin. vechol milla umilla ketiv bah (Mishlei 3:15) yekara hi mippeninim vechol chafatzim lo yishvu vah (beorayyta).

Vechol inun tippeshin, atimin delibba, kad chaman mille deorayyta, la day lon dela yade, ella deinun amre, deinhu millin pegimin, mille delet behu toalta. vavy lon, kad yitba lon kudesha berich hu, elbona deorayyta, veyitanneshun onasha demarde bemarehon.

Ma ketiv beorayyta, (Devarim 32) ki lo davar rek hu mikkem, vei ihu rek mikkem ihu, deha orayyta kolla, malyay mikkol avanin tavin umargelan yakkirin, mikkol tavin dealma. kema deat amer vechol chafatzim lo yishvu vah, vehech yemrun deihi rekanya.

Ushelomo malka amar, im chachamta chachamta lach, dechad yitchakkam bar nash beorayyta, toalta dileh ihu. deha beorayyta la yachil leosafa afillu at achat. velatzta levaddecha tissa, deha orayyta, la yiggara mishshivchaha kelum, veletzanuta, dileh ihu, veishtaar beh leovada leh mehay alma umealma deate.

Ta chaze, kad atvavn illain, mitchabberan kullehu behay darga, sofa dechol dargin kaddishin illain, veitmalleya minnayyhu, veitbarcha mealma illaa. keden, hay darga kayyma leashkaa lechullehu adarin, kol chad vechad kedka chaze leh, vechol chad vechad itshake min dina verachame.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyatztzeg et hammaklot asher fitztzel barhatim vegomer, deyaakov baa leatkana tefilla shel arvit, uleanhara lesihara, uleashkaa ulevarcha lah mikkol sitrin, dichtiv vayyatztzeg et hammaklot. illen dinin ugevuran denafke miggevura dilela.

Veyaakov kad baa leatkana lehay darga, salik lechol inun dinin ugevuran minah, veokim lon barhatim, beinun rehatim arba, dekayyme techot hay (Bamidbar 21:18) beer chafaruha sarim, deitmalyay meinun nachalin umabbuin illain. begin dechad nafkin mayin mehay beer kaddisha, illen arba natle kolla. veal da ikrun rehatim, umittamman
325: Atyayn kolla lemishte. veinun dinin ugevuran, kullehu kayyme tamman, lenatla lechol chad vechad kedka chaze leh.

Asher tavona hatztzon lishtot lenochach hatztzon, illen lokovel illen. vayyechamna, may vayyechamna. dechad mitatteran bedina, mitchammemin behahu dina, veazlin veshatin bealma, umeayyne bearchehon divne nasha, hen letav hen levish.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv batreh, (Bereshit 30:39) vayyechomu hatztzon el hammaklot, begin deinun maklot havu mitchammeman, umashgichin bedini alma, veitpakkedan aleh, veitdanu beni nasha alayyhu, kema deat amer (Daniel 4:14) bigzerat irin pitgama umemar kaddishin sheelta vegomer.

Ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 63:9) davka nafshi acharecha bi tamcha yeminecha, hay kera it leistakkala beh, davka nafshi acharecha, begin dedavid malka, hava mitdebak nafsheh tadir, avatreh dekudesha berich hu. vela chayish lemillin ochoranin dealma, ella leitdabbeka nafsheh ureuteh beh, vechevan deihu hava mitdebak bekudesha berich hu, (kudesha berich hu) hava tamich beh vela shavkeh. mikkan, levar nash kad ata leitdabbeka bekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu achid beh, vela shavik leh.

Davar acher davka nafshi acharecha, leitattera dargeh leela, deha kad itdabbak hahu darga (sefer acher dileh itbarcha vechad itgalyay) bedargin illain lesalka batrayyhu, keden yemina achid beh lesalka leh, ulechabbera leh, bechibbura chad kedka yeut, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 139:10) vetochazeni yeminecha, uchetiv (Shir HaShirim 2:6) vimino techabbekeni, veal da bi tamcha yeminecha.

Vechad achid beh bekudesha berich hu, keden ketiv, (sham) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. veihu yichuda chad vechibbura chad, vechad ihu chibbura chad, keden itmalleya hahu darga dileh veitbarcha.

Vechad itmalyayn kol inun rehatin, itmalyayn learba sitrin dealma, vechullehu adarayay ishtakkeyayn, kol chad vechad lesitreh. vechad ata yaakov leatkana hay darga, barir leh sitra dimina, deitchaze leh, vesitra ochora dela itchaze leh itparshat mineh. kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 30:40-41) vayyashet lo adarim levaddo velo shatam al tzon lavan. levaddo, hava bilchodoy, dela yishtammesh betaavavn ochoranin divsitrin ochoranin. zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael, dealayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha uvecha bachar Adonai vegomer.
Veta chaze, yaakov ihu tushebcha deavahan, veihu kelala dechullehu, uvegin deihu kelala decholla, begin kach ihu kaim leanhara lesihara, deyaakov ihu kaim leatkana litfillat arvit.

Vechol hahu tikkuna, ihu kedka chaze leh, (keden) kol inun sitrin kaddishin kullehu betikkuna atkin besitroy, veafrish chulakeh, mechulaka dishar amin. illen sitrin illain kaddishin bikdushsha illaa. veillen sitrin mesaavin, bimsaavan dimsaavuta.

Veha okimna, dichtiv vayyashet lo adarim levaddo. vayyashet lo, deatkin (leh) tikkunin limhemnuta. levaddo, kema deat amer, (sham) uvecha vachar Adonai lihyot lo leam segulla mikkol haammim. velo shatam al tzon lavan, dela shavve chulakeh veadveh immehon.

Veal da yaakov shelimu deavahan, atkin raza dimhemnuta, veafrish chulakeh veadveh, mechulaka veadva dishar ammin. veal da ketiv, (dabeham 4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

Ribbi abba amar, zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael, deinun illain al ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, begin dedarga dilhon leela, vedargin deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot letatta, illen besitra dikdusha, veillen besitra dimsaava, illen limina, veillen lismala.

Kevan deitcharav be makdesha, ma ketiv, (aykaheb) heshiv achor yemino mippene oyev, uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 60:7) hoshia yemincha vaaneni. usemala itgabbar umesaava ittakkaf, ad deyivni kudesha berich hu be makdesha, veyatkin alma al tikkunoy, vihadderun milleh kedka yeut veyitavar sitra mesaava min alma. veha ittemar, dichtiv (Zecharya 3) veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz vegomer,
326: Veyishtaar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:11) vehaelilim kalil yachalof, uchetiv, (sham) venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu. hu bilchodoy, kema dichtiv, (Devarim lak) veen immo el nechar, begin deyishtetze chela mesaava mealoma, vela yishtaar leela vetatta. ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, veyisrael lefulechaneh, am kaddish, veyitkere kaddish, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar birushalam kadosh yeamer lo kol hakkatuv lachayyim birushalami. ucheden yehe malka yechiday, leela vetatta, veamma yechidaa lefulechaneh, kema dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 17:21) umi keamcha yisrael goy echad baaretz.
Ribbi yitzchak verabbi yesa, havu azle bearcha, amar ribbi yesa, ha shechinta legabban nitassak bemille deorayyta, dechol man deasik bemille deorayyta veyishtaddal bah, zache leamshacha leh bahadeh.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar, (Tehillim 18:47) chay Adonai uvaruch tzuri veyarum elohe yishi, hay kera ihu raza. chay Adonai, vechi la yedana dekudesha berich hu ikre chay, ella afillu tzaddik, ihu ikre chay, deha chay, tzaddik ihu leela vetzaddik ihu letatta. leela kudesha berich hu ikre chay. letatta tzaddik ikre chay, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 23:20) uvenayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay, ammay ikre chay begin deihu tzaddik, deha tzaddik chay ikre, chay haolamim. uvaruch tzuri, kolla chad, chay uvaruch, dela mitparshe mehaddade, dechad mitchabberin kechada. ikre (Shir HaShirim 4:15) beer mayim chayyim. da nevia lego, veda itmalyay minneh.

Veyarum elohe yishi, da alma illaa, deihu ram venissa, ram al kolla. deha mineh nafik kolla, (mekora dela pasik) vechol neviu dinvia, leitmalyay bera kedka yeut. umittamman itbarcha, leanhara lechol inun diltatta, vechad (hay) itmalyay, kolla kedka yeut, keden veyarum elohe yishi.

Patach ribbi yesa veamar, (Iyov 36:7) lo yigra mitztzaddik enav veet melachim lakkisse vayyshivem lanetzach vayyigbahu, ta chaze, kad chayyayvaya la shaltin bealma veitavidu mineh, (bealma) (mealma) keden tzaddik ihu shallit bealma, hada hu dichtiv, (sham) lo yechayye rasha umishpat aniyyim yitten. ma ketiv batreh, lo yiggera mitztzaddik enav, mahu enav, kema deat amer (tehillim la) ene Adonai el tzaddikim.

Veet melachim lakkisse, illen inun melachin shallitin, deitachadan lakkisse. vayyshivem lanetzach, deitkayymu bekurseyay, bekiyyuma shelim. vayyigbahu, ammay vayyigbahu, leshaltaa bealma, veyitkayyem kurseyay al samchohi. davar acher vayyigbahu, denatle kurseyay, vezakfin lah leela, leitachada beatreh kedka yeut, ucheden kolla yichuda chada.

Ad dehavu azle, chamu chad bar nash, dehava ate vechad yenuka immeh, rachiv al kitfeh. amar ribbi yitzchak, vadday hay bar nash yuday ihu, uvegin lezakkaa livne nasha ka ate. amar ribbi yesa, nizke anan bekadmita beh.

Kad mata legabbayyhu, amar ribbi yesa an kista ditrima (sefer acher kaysatea daamayraa) bekirtoy deorcha, amar begin deyizkun (davar acher 33 bi) bene nesha, deha teren benin it li, veata turana lemata, veishtabbu. vehaidna azilna, begin deyizkun behu beni nasha. zachu bahadeh, veyahavu leh lemechal.

Adhachi patach hahu yuday veamar, (Bamidbar 28:2) et karbani lachmi leishshay vegomer. karbana dekudesha berich hu bechol yoma, begin lemezan alma ulemehav sippuka leela vetatta. deha beitaruta diltatta, itar leela. uveda mistappekin kol chad vechad kedka yeut.

Et karbani lachmi, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) achalti yaari im divshi shatiti yiyini im chalavi. leishshay, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) ichlu reim vegomer, uma kudesha berich hu pakkid leitara mezona leela (letatta) begin leitara mezona (leella) letatta mehahu mezona. man deyahiv mezona lekayyma nafsha, al achat kamma vechamma dekudesha berich hu barich leh, veyitar leh mezona dilela, veyitbarach alma begineh.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, vadday raza da kedka chaze, veshappir kaamar. amar ribbi yesa, vadday al da amru, dela yezalzel bar nash, leshum bar nash ochora bealma, bitre gavvni zachina lehay bar nash.
327: Ribbi elazar (Bamidbar 28:2) et karbani lachmi leishshay, et karbani, raza dichneset yisrael. dichtiv et, et dayyka. karbani, da ihu karbana, vekishshura leitkashshera. lachmi, da mezona deate milela, beitaruta diltatta. leishshay, leitkelala shear chelin ochoranin deitzterichu leittezana, kol chad vechad kedka chaze leh. reach nichochi, da reuta vekishshura, deitachada kolla beraza dealma illaa.

Tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado, man moado, bizman deitar avraham lemebad reuteh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:3) vayyashkem avraham babboker. uvezimna deitakad yitzchak al gabbe madbecha, dehahi shata, ben haarbayim hava. veamar ribbi (chiyyay) yesa, i hachi, hay dichtiv bemoado, bemoadim mibbae leh. amar leh, hahi shata, itkelil esha bemaya umaya beesha, uvegin kach ketiv bemoado.

Ta chaze, bechol karbanin la ketiv kema dichtiv hacha, tishmeru lehakeriv li. tishmeru, raza deshamor, deihu tzericha lekarva legabbe ela, dichtiv tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado. bimina usemala, kema deittemar beavraham veyitzchak, vecholla beraza illaa.

Amar ribbi yesa ilmale la atena hacha, ella lemishma millin illen, dayyay. zakkain inun yisrael, bealma den uvealma deate. al da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer.

(Bereshit 31:19) velavan halach ligzoz et tzono vegomer. amar ribbi yose man terafim, ella avoda zara havu, veammay ikre terafim, lignay hava, kema detaninan bemakom hattoref. umenalan deavoda zara havu, dichtiv, (sham) lamma ganavta et elohay. uchetiv, (sham) im asher timtza et elohecha vegomer. velavan charasha dechol chorashin dealma hava, uvehay hava yada bechol man devae leminda.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, bekesem itavid. ribbi yose omer, benachash. amar ribbi yehuda, la itavidu ella beshate yedian. veammay ikre terafim. begin devatshe hay shata, vehay shata arpe yeda, kema deat amer, (Shmuel 2 24:16) rav atta heref yadecha.

Umana kad avid leh, hahu deyada rige veshate kaim aleh, veamar, hasheta arpe, vehasheta avid. vela tishkach avidta deitzterich deyirpun minah ella hay. veihu mallil tadir, veyahiv etin bishin leavasha lenafsheh devar nash.

Verachel dechilat, begin deyahav eta leavasha leh leyaakov, uvegin bizyona deavoda zara, shavve lon techotah, ad dela yachil lemallala. deha kad ihu mittakkan lemallala, mechabbedin umarbitzin kammeh, vehasheta ma ketiv, (Bereshit 31:34) vatteshev alehem. dechar venukeva havu, ufulechanin saggiin ka avdin ad la memallelan. uvegini kach itakkav lavan telat yomin, dela yada dearak yaakov, dichtiv, (sham) vayyuggad lelavan bayyom hashshelishi ki varach yaakov.

Veamar ribbi yehuda, zammin garmeh bitren millin, izdaraz bechol chorashin dehava leh veizdaraz bezayynin, begin leovada leh min alma, dichtiv (Devarim 26:5) arammi oved avi. kevan dechama kudesha berich hu, devaa leovada leyaakov. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 31:24) hishshamer lecha pen tedabber im yaakov mittov ad ra. vehayeynu dichtiv, (sham) yesh leel yadi laasot immachem ra. bamme itrechitz, bochorashin dehavu bideh.

Ta chaze, lavan azal beyoma chad, orach shiva yamim deazal yaakov, begin leaakara leh min alma. chad, al deazal. vechad, al inun terafim. veaf al gav derachel ihi avdat leaakara leh laavuha mibbatar avoda zara, itanashat. dela reviat leh levinyamin, vela kayyma bahadeh shata chada, begin tzaara deavuha, af al gav deitkavvevnat letav.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, kol hahi tochachta dehava leh leyaakov belavan. ahadar leh lelavan, leodaa leh lekudesha berich hu, dichtiv (Bereshit 31:50) ree elohim ed beni uvenecha. ta chaze, ketiv, (Bereshit 31:53) elohe avraham vilohe nachor yishpetu benenu, ahadar hahu rasha letakleh, kevan deamar elohe avraham, ahadar veamar vilohe nachor.
328: (Bereshit 31:53) vayyishshava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak, may tama befachad yitzchak, vela belohe avraham. ella, dela vaa leatracha limina begineh delavan. vela od, ela dela libbae leh leinish, af al gav deome bekusheta, leomaa beatar illaa decholla.

Amar ribbi yose, vadday lekiyyuma (sefer acher leumaa) kedka yeut, ome yaakov kach, vehachi itchaze, veyaakov ashgach bemilla, amar, ha ihu amar elohe avraham, veshavak leabba, ana ashlim kolla, miyyad vayyishshava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak. davar acher, leitkelala bedina, lemekam aleh delavan.

(Bereshit 32:2) veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu vo malache elohim. ribbi abba patach veamar, (Bereshit Adonai:2) zachar unekeva beraam vegomer, kamma it lan leistakkala bemille deorayyta. vavy lon leinun atime libba usetimin ayynin, ha orayyta kare kammayyhu, (Mishlei 9:Adonai-6) lechu lachamu velachmi ushetu beyayin masachti. (sham) mi peti yasur henna chasar lev amra lo, velet man deyashgach.

Ta chaze, hay kera, it beh razin ilain, ihu lego, veihu levar. zachar unekeva beraam, ishtema lehay gavvna, veishtema lehay gavvna. veishtema deshimsha vesihara bechibbura chada inun, dichtiv beraam. kema deat amer, (Chavakuk 3:11) shemesh yareach amad zevula. veishtema, deadam vechavva kechada itberiu, beziuuga chad. vechevan deishtakkachu beziuuga chad, miyyad vayvarech otam. delet birchata sharya, ella beatar deishtakkachu dechar venukeva.

Ta chaze, kad nafak yaakov lemehach lecharan, bilchodoy hava, dela insiv. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 28:11) vayyifga bammakom vegomer, vela ativu leh ella bechelma, hasheta deinsiv vehava ate bechullehu shivtin. kivyachol mashshiryayn illain, pagin beh, veitchannenu leh. dichtiv vayyifgeu vo, inun ahadaru lemifga beh. bekadmita ihu vayyifga bammakom, hasheta inun vayyifgeu vo.

Begin divgineh deyaakov uveinun shivtin, itshakyayn inun mimmaya deyamma rabba. vela od, ella bekadmita ballayla bechelma. hasheta bechezu deena, uvimama. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:3) vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam machane elohim ze vegomer.

Sitre tora (Bereshit 32:2) veyaakov halacha ledarko vayyippegu vo malache elohim. mattenittin, tokpe dehuremne, zekippin milleela, veshinnena decharba dimlahata memanna al kol (sefer acher kema) chelin umashiryayn.

Hahu charba melahata, hi charba sumeka. dichtiv, (yeshaya la) cherev laAdonai mala dam. hahu charba detalya beh hippucha, inun dimhappeche lechamma gevavnin. hu nashyayn, hu guverin, besitrin saggiin, mitteparshin gevavnin ochoranin lechamma dargin.

Missitra deilana dechayye, nappeke inun. demitteyachade beyichuda bekishura. kaddishin illen, ishtaavan tadir mital hashamayim, shemeh delokim, ittetakkin behu. (sefer acher veal da amar mishmanne haaretz veittakkan) bearba sitrin dealma, itteavidu samchin dekurseyay. kullehu margelitin, shayypin vesamchin, la mitteparshin lealma. miggo da shema, inun kishurin deyaakov, devarir lechulakeh. umittekashran bishma da, kullehu nappeku (beerev) (beyaakov).

Veyaakov kad nappak lemezal learcheh, learba sitrin akippu leh, learba zavvyayn dealma natru leh, beshata kalla ittergish meilana (sefer acher meatar) leela, lemitar ilana diltatta, ucheden (Bereshit 30:25) vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam machane elohim ze. keden (Bereshit 30:25) vayyikra shem hammakom hahu machanayim. (nidpas daf 158 amud bet vesham meforash)

Amar rabbi yehuda, ta chaze, shelemutteh deyaakov, dela bae (baa) lemezal ella birshutteh delavan, vei tema, zimna ochora ammay la. ella begin dedachil yaakov dela yishbok leh, veyishtelimu teresar shivtin beara ochora. veal da kevan dechama demata shata devinyamin, barach. kema deat amer, (Bereshit lo) vayyivrach hu vechol asher lo. dechevan deitteyalid binyamin, ittekashar shechinta bechullehu shivtin, venatal betta behu. veyaakov hava yada berucha dechachmeta, dechad yishtallimu teresar shivtin, dishchinta tittekashar behu, verachel tamutt, veihi natla betta.
Veta chaze, hachi olippena, alma tattaa, ittechaze leh leyaakov, kema deittechaze leh lemoshe, ella dela
329: Ishtemoda lon, ela chama, deinun havu, inun dechama bechelma, begine kach kara lon machanayim, mashshiryayn deitchazu leela, umashshiryayn deitchazu letatta.

Ammay itgalliu lemifga leh. ela shechinta azla legabbeh, lenatla leveteh. umechakka leh levinyamin, lenatla beta immeh deyaakov kedka yeut. ucheden ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 46:27) veshav yaakov vshakat veshaanan ven macharid. baruch Adonai leolam amen vamen. (ad kan parashat vayyetze)

Yechilatt, ad dehavu 12 shivtin bevetta, leittekashra behu. ucheden, ittedachyayt rachel, unetalatt ihi betta bechullehu shivtin, vehavatt ikra devetta. ucheden (Tehillim 113:9) moshivi akerett habbayitt. amar yaakov, ha mata zimna deyishtallimu 12 shivtin, uvadday alma dilela yechutt leh levetta, vittekashra (nusach acher alma dilella yechot leh beveteh, vaatakesharea) behu, umiskenatta da ittedachyay kammeh. i timutt hacha, la eppok mikkan lealmin. velo od, ella beara da, la ittechaze leashlama betta. begin kacha, (Bereshit 30:25) vayhi kaasher yalda rachel ett yosef, ad la yishtallimu shivtin.

Shama ribbi shimon, amar, vday kol milloy deribbi yehuda shappir, veda salik al kolla. vei tema, ammay la azal leh learcheh miyyad. ella, kol zimna derachel la mitteabbera mibbinyamin, itteakkav tamman. kevan demata zimna devinyamin, arak, vela vaa reshutta. begin dela yitteakkav tamman, vittechabbar yaakov bechullehu shivtin, beattar deitztzetricha. (70" parashat vayyetze)
330: Vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam vegomer. umeinun malachin shaddar leh leesav hada hu dichtiv vayyishlach yaakov malachim, malachim mammash havu vadday.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar ketiv, (Tehillim 35:5) chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem, ha ukemuha. aval beatar chad ketiv ki malachav yetzavve lach, malachav saggiin, vehacha chad dichtiv chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem. ella ki malachav yetzavve lach, illen shear malachin. malach Adonai saviv da shechinta, kema deat amer, (Shemot 3:2) vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene. uvegin kach chone malach Adonai saviv lireav, laakafa leh bechol sitrin begin leshezava leh. vechad shechinta sharya begavveh devar nash, kamma mashshiryayn kaddishin kullehu izdammenu letamman.

Ta chaze, kad david malka ishteziv meachish melech gat keden amar hay, begin dishchinta sachara leh veishteziv minnayyhu meachish umeammeh kol inun deatkifu (nusach acher daakaypav) beh, ma ketiv, (Shmuel 1 21:14) vayyitholel beyadam, ammay vayyitholel, vayyishtaggea mibbae leh, kema deat amer, (sham) ki hevetem et ze lehishtaggea alay.

Ella ahadar al hahu milla deamar david bekadmita dichtiv, (Tehillim 73:3) ki kinneti bahollim vegomer. amar leh kudesha berich hu chayyecha adayin ant itzterich lehay, kevan deal leve achish veatkifu beh, ma ketiv vayyitholel beyadam, keinun hollim dekanne bekadmita, ucheden atya shechinta vesharya sacharaneh dedavid.

Vei tema shechinta la sharya ella (baachasenateh) beachsanteh, deihi ara kaddisha. vadday la sharya begin (deyankin) linaka minnah, aval laagana sharya. vehacha kad ata yaakov mibbe lavan kullehu mashshiryayn kaddishin sacharan leh vela ishtaar bilchodoy.

Amar ribbi chizkiya i hachi (sefer acher dechullehu mashshiryayn kaddishin oto bahehah ushechinta bahadeh), ammay ketiv vayyivvater yaakov levaddo vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda begin deail garmeh lesakkana, vehava chame lehahi sakkana beenoy, inun itparshu minneh, ucheden amar katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet, illen inun mashshiryayn kaddishin deitparshu minneh.

Ribbi yitzchak amar begin leshavka leh im hahu memanna deesav devirshuta illaa hava ate. veillen azle lememar shirata demata zimnayyhu leshabbacha leh lekudesha berich hu behahi shata, ulevatar ahadaru, hada hu dichtiv katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet asher asita et avdecha vegomer, veatta hayiti lishne machanot. machane shechinta, vechol beteh, (sefer acher machane chad hava dichtiv machane elohim ze), lishni machanot, dehava shelim michol sitrin mitteren chulakin chivvavr vesumak.

Ribbi elazar amar, ha ittemar, hahu lelya shuletanuta desitra deesav hava. behahi shata deha ketiv (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot chaser, uvegin kach vayyivvater yaakov levaddo, deishtaar yaakov deihu shimsha bilchodoy, deitkasya sihara min shimsha. veaf al gav dintiru (sefer acher veim kol da netiru) dekudesha berich hu la itade minneh mikkol vachol, veal da lo yachol lo, dichtiv vayyar ki lo yachol lo.

Istakkal limina vechama leavraham. istakkal lismala vechama leyitzchak. istakkal begufa vechama deitkelil missitra da veitkelil missitra da, keden vayyiga bechaf yerecho. bechad ammuda desamich legufa deihu levar min gufa.

Uvegin kach chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem, akkif leh bechol sitroy begin leshezava leh, vechad shara shechinta begavveh (sefer acher legabbeh) kamma chelin umashshiryayn atu bahadeh, umeinun malachin shaddar legabbeh deesav:

Vayyishlach yaakov malachim, amar ribbi abba vechi ammay itar ihu legabbeh deesav, vetav hava leh leishtuke minneh. ella amar yaakov yedana deesav chayyish leh likara deabba ulealam la argiz kammeh, veha yedana hoil veabba kayyaym la mistafina minneh, aval hasheta (hoil deabba kaim beena laatapeyys 0) immeh, miyyad vayyishlach yaakov malachim lefanav.
Vayyishlach yaakov malachim. ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Mishlei 12:9) tov nikla veeved lo mimmitkabbed vachasar lechem, hay kera al yetzer
331: Hara ittemar, begin deihu mekatrega tadir legabbe bene nasha, veyetzer hara ihu arim libbeh ureuteh devar nash begaavata veazil avatreh mesalsel saareh uveresheh ad deihu itgae aleh umashich leh laggehinnom.

Aval tov nikla, hahu dela azil avatreh deyetzer hara vela itgae kelal umaich rucheh velibbeh ureuteh legabbe kudesha berich hu, ucheden hahu yetzer hara mithappech leeved lo, dela yachil leshaltaa aloy, vehahu bar nash shallit aloy kema deat amer, (Bereshit 4:7) veatta timshal bo.

Mimmitkabbed, kema deamaran deihu okir garmeh mesalsel besaareh itgae berucheh, veihu chasar lechem, chasar mehemnuta kema deat amer, (Vayikra 21:17) lechem elohav vegomer (Vayikra 21:6) lechem elohehem hem makrivim vegomer.

Davar acher tov nikla (vaavad lo), da yaakov demaich rucheh legabbeh deesav. begin dilvatar leheve eved lo veyishlot aloy veyitkayyaym beh (Bereshit 27:29) yaavducha ammim veyishtachavu lecha leumim vegomer, vaadayin la hava zimneh kelal. ella begin desalik leh yaakov levatar yomaya, veal da hava miyyad nikla. ulevatar hahu deihu mitkabbed yehe eved lo, hahu deihu chasar lechem yehe avda lehahu deyahavu leh rov dagan vetirosh.

Ta chaze, al da begin deyada yaakov deitzterich leh, hasheta ithappach leh nikla. veyoter chachma vaakimu avad beda, mikkol ma deavad legabbe deesav. deilu hava yada esav chachma da yiktil leh legarmeh vela yete leda, aval kolla avad bechachmeta, vealeh amra channa (Shmuel 1 2:10) Adonai yechattu merivav vegomer veyitten oz lemalko vegomer:

Vaytzav otam lemor ko tomrun ladoni leesav ko amar avdecha yaakov im lavan garti vaechar ad atta. miyyad patach yaakov leithappacha leh leavda, begin dela yistakkal esav beinun birchan devarcheh avoy, deha yaakov salik lon levatar kedka amaran.

Amar ribbi yehuda may chama yaakov deshaddar leh leesav veamar im lavan garti, vechi ma avid bishlichuteh deesav (deamar) milla da. ella lavan haarammi kaleh azil bealma dela hava var nash deyishteziv minneh, dehu hava charash bechorashin verav bekosmin, vaavoy divor hava, uveor avoy devilam, dichtiv (Yehoshua 13:22) bilam ben beor hakkosem, velavan chacham bechorashin vekosmin yattir mikkullehu, veim kol da la yachil beyaakov. uvaa leovada leyaakov bechamma zayynin hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 26:5) arammi oved avi.

Amar ribbi abba kule alma have yade delavan hava rav chakkimin vochorashin vekosmin, uman devae leovada bechorashoy la ishteziv minneh, vechol ma deyada bilam minneh hava. uchetiv beh bevilam (Bamidbar 22:6) ki yadati et asher tevarech mevorach vaasher taor yuar. vechule alma havu mistafe millavan umechorashoy, umilla kadmaa deshaddar yaakov leesav amar im lavan garti. vei tema dizer hava yerach o shatta. lav hachi, ella vaechar ad atta, esrin shenin itacharit immeh.

Vei tema dela salik beyadi kelum. vayhi li shor vachamor, inun teren gizre dinin, dechad mitchabberan tarvavyyhu kechada, la mitchabberan ela leavasha alma. uvegin kach ketiv, (Devarim 22:10) lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav.

Tzon veeved veshifcha, ilen inun kitre tattae dekatal kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim (Shemot 12:29) bechor behema (Shemot 12:29) bechor hashshevi (Shemot 11:5) bechor hashshifcha, hada hu dichtiv tzon veeved veshifcha. miyyad mistafe hava esav venafak lokodamuteh, udechilu hava leh miyyaakov kema dehava leh leyaakov meesav.

Levar nash dehava azil bearcha, ad dehava azil shama al chad listim dehava kaman bearcha, paga beh var nash ochora. amar leh mimman ant, amar leh mippeloni ligyon ana, amar leh sete lach miggabbay dechol man dekariv bahaday chad chivya ana mayyte vekatil leh. azal hahu var nash lehahu ligyon, amar leh chad var nash ate vechol man di kariv bahadeh nashcheh chad chivya dehu mayyte
332: Shama hahu ligyon vedachil, amar yaot deezil lekovleh veitpayes bahadeh. ad dechama leh hahu var nash, amar, vavy dehashta yikteleneh hahu ligyon. share sagid vechara lekovleh. amar hahu ligyon, ilmale hava leh bideh chivya lekatla, la segid kulay hay lekovli. share ligyonaa leitgaa, amar, hoil vechol kach kara lekivli la ektelineh.

Kacha amar yaakov im lavan garti vaechar ad atta, esrin shenin itacharit immeh veana mayyte chivya lekatla beni nasha. shema esav, amar, vavy man yakum kammeh. dehashta yiktelineh yaakov befumeh, share nafik lokodamuteh leitpayysa immeh.

Kevan dechama leh ma ketiv vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo, kevan dekariv bahadeh share kara vesagid lekovleh. hada hu dichtiv vayyishtachu artza sheva peamim ad gishto ad achiv. amar esav ilmale kol kach hava immeh, la segid lekivli, share leitgaa.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv bevilam (Bamidbar 22:20) vayyavo elohim el bilam layla. belavan ketiv (Bereshit 31:24) vayyavo elohim el lavan haarammi bachalom hallayla vayyomer lo hishshamer lecha pen tedabber im yaakov mittov vegomer. pen tedabber, pen taase leyaakov raa mibbae leh. ella lavan la radaf avatreh deyaakov bechela deguverin laagacha beh kerava. deha chela deyaakov uvenoy rav minneh, ella lemikteleh befumeh uleshetzaa kolla. hada hu dichtiv arammi oved avi. uvegin kach pen tedabber, vela ketiv pen taase. uchetiv yesh leel yadi laasot. minnayin hava yada diycholta hava bideh. ella kema deittemar elohe avichem emesh amar elay vegomer.

Veda hu sahaduta, depakkid kudesha berich hu leashada. dichtiv (Devarim 26:5) veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha arammi oved avi vegomer. veanita, kema deat amer, (Shemot 20:13) lo taane vereacha. (Devarim 19:18) ana veachiv.

Ketiv beh bevilam (Bamidbar 24:1) velo halach chefaam befaam likrat nechashim, dehachi hu archeh deihu hava menachesh. belavan ketiv, (Bereshit 30) nichashti, deashgach bacharashoy uviksamoy beiska deyaakov, vechad baa leovada leyaakov binchasha uvacharasha dileh baa leovadeh, vela shavkeh kudesha berich hu.

Vehayeynu deamar bilam bar bereh (Bamidbar 23:23) ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael, man yachil lehon, deha savay baa leovada laavuhon binchashim uviksamim dileh vela selika bidoy. dela shavkeh lelatya. hada hu dichtiv ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael.

Uvechullehu asara zine chorashin vekosmin dekuzetfe dechitrin tattain avad lavan lekovleh deyaakov vela yachil. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 31:41) vattachlef et maskurti aseret monim. dechullehu avad lavan lekovleh vela seliku bidoy leavasha leh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 31:7) vehecholif et maskurti aseret monim velo netano elohim lehara immadi. may monim, ketargum zinin, uchetiv (Vayikra 17:7) lasseirim asher hem zonim acharehem. monim, minim kemashmao. vaasara zinin inun decharashin vekosmin bechitrin tattain vechullehu avad lekovleh.
Asara zinin inun, dichtiv, (Devarim 18:10-11) kosem kesamim meonin umenachesh umechashshef vechover chaver veshoel ov veyidoni vedorish el hammetim, ha asara inun.

Amar ribbi yose nachash vekesem, tere zine inun, uvedarga chad salkin. vechad ata bilam bekesem avad lekivlehon deyisrael. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 22:7) ukesamim beyadam. ulekovleh deyaakov ata lavan benachash, hay vehay la seliku bidayyhu hada hu dichtiv, (sham 23) ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael. ki lo nachash beyaakov bekadmita beyomoy delavan. velo kesem beyisrael levatar beyomoy devilam.

Amar bilam levalak, ta chaze, man yachil lehon. dechol kesamin vacharashin divchitrin dilan, mikkizfa demalchuta dilela (vetatta) mitatteran (deha), vehu itkashshar behu, dichtiv Adonai elohav immo uteruat melech bo.
Amar ribbi yehuda chas veshalom dehava yada bilam bikdusha dilela
333: Kelal. deha kudesha berich hu la itrae beam velishan ochora deyishtammesh bikareh, ella benoy kaddishin. veamar (Vayikra 11:44) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim, man deinun kaddishin yishtamshun bikdushsha, yisrael inun kaddishin dichtiv, (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta. atta kadosh vela am ochora.

Man deinun mesaavin, mesaavu izdamman lon leistaava aleh. ketiv, (Vayikra 13:46) tame hu badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo. umesaava limsaava kare dichtiv, (sham) vetame tame yikra, man deihu tame, letame yikra, kola azil batar zineh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, yaot hu leyaakov dehava kaddisha lomar deistaav belavan uvacharashoy, o shevacha hu dileh. amar leh ribbi yose, af al gav dekaamar rabbi yehuda, ana mesayyea lach. deha ketiv, (Bereshit 27:19) anochi esav bechorecha. vechi yaot hu letzaddika keyaakov lemichlaf shemeh bishma dimsaava, ella anochi, paska tama. veamar anochi man deana, aval esav bechorecha veha ukemuha.

Uf hacha, vayhi li shor vachamor, lomar la teshavve libbach ureutach lehahi birchata devarich li abba deitkeyyaym bi. hu barich li hevi gevir leachecha veyishtachavu lecha bene immecha, begin kach avdecha yaakov. ladoni leesav. hu barich li berov dagan vetirosh. ha la itkeyyaym bi, dela otzarna lon. ella, vayhi li shor vachamor tzon veeved, rae ana bechakla. hu barich li, mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz. ha la itkeyyaym bi, begin deha im lavan garti, kegiyyora. dela hava li beta chada kol shekken mishmanne haaretz. vechol da begin dela yistakkal beh beyaakov al inun birchan vikatreg immeh.

Ribbi abba amar ketiv beh beyaakov (Bereshit 25:27) ish tam yoshev ohalim, gevar shelim. begin deihu yetiv bitren mishkanin illain. veashlim lehay gisa ulehay gisa, veihu la amar deistaav bacharashoy. aval al ma dekaamar ribbi yehuda, begin delibboy shelim al tivu ukeshot deavid leh kudesha berich hu. dechol alma yade ovadoy delavan man inun, uman yachil leishtezava (sefer acher minneh, kol asrin shenin dahevaytay immeh) mikkitruga dileh devae leovada li. (sefer acher vaana yativna veavadna immeh asrin shenin) vekudesha berich hu shezvani minneh. vecholla hava begin dela yistakkal beh esav deitkayyeymu beh inun birchan, vela yintar leh devavu. veal da ketiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vegomer, uchetiv, (Devarim 18:13) tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha:

Vayyashuvu hammalachim el yaakov lemor banu el achicha el esav vegam holech likratcha vearba meot ish immo. kevan deamar banu el achicha, la yedana deihu esav, vechi achin ochoranin havu leyaakov. ella banu el achicha, vei tema dehadar bitshuva veazil beorach metakkena, lav hachi, ella esav harasha kidmeikkara. vegam holech likratcha, vei tema deihu bilchodoy azil. lav, ela arba meot ish immo.

Vechol kach lamma, (ella inun) amru leh, begin dekudesha berich hu itrae tadir bitzlothon detzaddikaya umitatter bitzlothon. kidamrinan, dehahu malacha dimmanna al tzelothon deyisrael, sandalfon shemeh, natil kol inun tzelotin veavid minnayyhu atara lechaye haolamim veukemuha. vechol shekken tzelothon detzaddikayya dekudesha berich hu itrae behu veitavdan atara leitattera beinun tzelotin lekudesha berich hu. vei tema mashshiryayn kaddishin havu atyayn immeh, ammay dachil. ella tzaddikayay la samchin al zechutayyhu, ella al tzelothon uvautehon legabbe marehon.

Veta chaze, deamar ribbi shimon, tzelota desaggiin salik kamme kudesha berich hu umitatter behahu tzelota. begin desalka bigvavnin saggiin veitkelilat mikkamma sitrin. uvegin deitkelilat mikkamma gevavnin itavidat atara umancha al resha detzaddik chay haolamim. utzelota deyachid lav ihi kelila, velav ihi ella begavvavn chad. veal da tzelota deyachid lav ihu mittakna leitkabbela (ella bitzlota) kitzlota desaggiin. veta chaze, yaakov kalil hava, veal da tzeloteh taiv lah kudesha berich hu. ma ketiv vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo.
Ribbi yehuda patach veamar (Mishlei 28:14) ashre adam mefached tamid umakshe libbo yippol beraa.
334: Zakkain inun yisrael dekudesha berich hu itrae behu, veyahav lon orayyta dikshot begin lemizke vah lechayye alma, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta kudesha berich hu mashich aleh chayyin illain, veail leh lechayye alma deate, dichtiv, (Devarim 30:20) ki hi chayyecha veorech yamecha. uchetiv, (sham 32) uvaddavar hazze taarichu yamim. chayyin behay alma vechayin bealma deate.

Ribbi elazar amar kol man deishtaddal beorayyta lishmah, lav mitateh al yeda deyetzer hara, begin (gillayon dehu nachash vehu malacha demota. ella mitathon binshika dichtiv 0 yashkeni minneshikot pihu, kelomar al pi Adonai, vehi hanneshika dehi dabeykevatea denafsha baaykeraa, vehahi deishtaddal beorayyta) deittakkif beilana dechayye vela arpe minneh, uvegin kach tzaddikaya demishtaddele beorayyta la mistaave gufa dilhon (gillayon ella hu dechi, kegon eliyyahu beve kivre daashakechavehav rabbanan, usheilu leh velav kohen hu mar, amar lon tzadikaya lo misave bemitathon, kema detanenan beyom shemmet rabbi betela kehunna, kelomar daataasakev beh) dela shara alayyhu ruach mesaava.

Yaakov ilana dechayye hava, ammay dachil, deha la yachol leshaltaa aloy. veod deha ketiv vehinne anochi immach vegomer, ammay hava dachil. vetu deha ketiv vayyifgeu vo malache elohim. i mashshiryayn kaddishin havu immeh ammay hava dachil.

Ella kolla yaot hava, veyaakov la hava bae lemismach al nissa dekudesha berich hu, begin dechashiv delav ihu keday dekudesha berich hu yaavid leh nissa. may tama, begin dela falach leavoy uleimmeh kedka yeut, vela ishtaddal beorayyta venatal tere achayot. veaf al gav decholla ittemar, veim kol da bae leh levar nash lemidchal tadir uletzallaa kamme kudesha berich hu bitzlota. dichtiv ashre adam mefached tamid (ulemidchal tadir kamme kudesha berich hu) veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, tzelota deavahan kayymu alma, vechol bene alma alayyhu kayyme vesamchin. lealam ulealme almin, la itneshe zechuta deavahan, begin dizchuta deavahan ihu kiyyuma deela vetatta, vekiyyuma deyaakov ihu kiyyuma shelim yattir mikkullehu. uvegin kach beshata deaku livnoy deyaakov, kudesha berich hu achme kammeh diukena deyaakov vechayis al alma kema deat amer, (Vayikra 26:42) vezacharti et beriti yaakov. yaakov beVav, ammay beVav, begin deihu diukena deyaakov mammash.

Ta chaze, kol man dechame leh leyaakov keman deistakkel beaspaklarya denahara, veha ittemar deshufereh deyaakov keshufereh deadam kadmaa. amar ribbi yesa, ana shemana dechol man deistakkal bechelmeh vechama leh leyaakov mekustar bekusefoy, chayyin ittosfan leh.

Ribbi shimon amar, ha ittemar dedavid malka ad la hava, la havu leh chayyim kelal. bar deadam kadmaa yahav leh shivin shenin middileh, vechach hava kiyyumeh dedavid malka shivin shenin havu. vekiyyuma deadam kadmaa elef shenin chasar shivin. ishtakkachu behanne elef shenin kadmae, adam harishon vedavid malka.

Patach veamar (Tehillim 21:5) chayyim shaal mimcha natatta lo orech yamim olam vaed. chayyim shaal mimcha, da david malka. deha kad bara kudesha berich hu ginta deeden attil beh nishmata dedavid malka, veistakkal beh vechame delet leh chayyim middileh kelum. vekayyma kammeh kol yoma. kevan devara adam harishon amar ha vadday kiyyumeh, umeadam kadmaa havu shivin shenin deitkeyyaym david malka bealma.
Tu avahan shavku leh mechayyehon kol chad vechad, avraham shavak leh, vechen yaakov veyosef. yitzchak la shavak leh kelum, begin dedavid malka missitreh ka ata.

Vadday avraham shavak leh chamesh shenin, dehava leh leitkayyeyma mea utemanin shenin, veitkeyyaym mea veshivin vechamesh shenin, chaserin chamesh. yaakov hava leh leitkayyma bealma keyome deavraham, vela itkeyyaym
335: Ella mea vearbain vesheva shenin, chaserim temanya veesrin. ishtakkachu deavraham veyaakov shevaku leh mechayyehon telatin utelat shenin. yosef deitkeyyaym mea veeser shenin, hava leh leitkayyayma mea vearbain vesheva shenin keyome deyaakov, vechaser minnehon telatin vesheva shenin. ha shivin shenin dishvaku leh ledavid malka leitkayyma behon, uvehu itkayaym david bechol inun shenin dishvaku leh avahan.

Vei tema yitzchak ammay la shavak leh kelum kehanne, begin deihu choshech vedavid missitra dechoshech ka ata, uman deihu bachoshech let leh nehora kelal velet leh chayyim. uvegin kach la havu ledavid chayyim kelal. aval illen dehavu lehon nehora, nehiru leh ledavid malka, uminnayyhu itzterich leanhara ulemehve leh chayyim, deha missitra dechoshech let leh chayyim kelal, veal da la ata yitzchak bechushebna.

Vei tema yosef ammay yattir mikkullehu. ella vadday yosef bilchodoy, kechullehu begin deikre tzaddik, veda hu deanhir lesihara yattir mikkullehu. uvegin kach hay shavak leh ledavid malka yatir mikkullehu chayyin, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:17) vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim lehair al haaretz.

Ta chaze yaakov tzeloteh agin leh meesav, begin devaa lesalka zechuteh livnoy avatreh vela leafaka leh hasheta legabbeh deesav. veal da tzale tzeloteh lekudesha berich hu, vela istemich al zechuteh, leshezava leh beginih:

Vayyomer im yavo esav el hammachan haachat vehikkahu vehaya hammachan hannishar lifleta. ta chaze, ma ketiv vayyachatz et haam asher itto veet hatztzon veet habbakar vehaggemallim lishne machanot. ammay lishne machanot. begin deamar im yavo esav el hammachan haachat vehikkahu vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta.

Ta chaze, shechinta la adiat meohel lea umeohel rachel. amar yaakov yadana deha netiru lon leillen min kudesha berich hu. ma avad vayyasem et hashshefachot veet yaldehen rishona, amar im yaktil esav, leillen yaktel. aval illen la mistafina minnayyhu, begin dishchinta immehon. veal da vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta. kevan deavid hay atkin tzeloteh alayyhu, ma ketiv vayyomer yaakov elohe avi avraham vilohe avi yitzchak Adonai haomer elay shuv leartzecha ulemoladtecha veetiva immach.

Ribbi yose patach veamar (Tehillim 102:1) tefilla leani chi yaatof velifni Adonai yishpoch sicho. hay kera ukemuha bechamma atar. ella david malka amar da kad istakkal vechama bemille demiskena, veistakkal beh kad hava azil vearak mikkamme chamoy amar da. tefilla leani, da hu tzelota devae miskena kamme kudesha berich hu, veda tzelota deakdimat lechol tzelothon dealma.

Ketiv hacha tefilla leani uchetiv hatam (Tehillim 90:1) tefilla lemoshe ish haelohim, ma ben hay lehay. ella da tefilla shel yad veda tefilla shel rosh, velet leafrasha ben hay tefilla leani uven tefilla lemoshe ish haelohim, vetarvavyyhu shekilin kechad.

Veal da tzelota deani akdimat kamme kudesha berich hu mikkol tzelotin dealma, begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 22:25) ki lo vaza velo shikkatz enut ani vegomer. ta chaze, tefilla leani, da tefilla shel yad. deani itdabbak bemiskenuteh, keman delet leh miggarmeh kelum.
Davar acher tefilla da moshe. leani da david. ki yaatof, kad itkasseya sihara veitkasse shimsha minah. velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho, begin leitchabbera bahade shimsha.

Ta chaze, tzelota dechol bene nasha tzelota. utzelota demiskena ihi tzelota dekayyma kammeh dekudesha berich hu vetavar tarin ufitchin vealat leitkabbala kammeh hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 22:26) vehaya chi yitzak elay veshamati ki channun ani, uchetiv shamoa eshma tzaakato. velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho, keman demitraem al dinoy dekudesha berich hu.
Amar ribbi elazar tzelothon detzaddikayay chedvavta lichneset yisrael
336: Leitattara kameh kudesha berich hu, vegin kach chaviva hu yattir kammeh kudesha berich hu. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu taiv litzlothon detzaddikayyay beshata deitzterich lon, begin deyade leratztzuye lemarehon.

Ma ketiv beh beyaakov elohe avi avraham velohe avi yitzchak Adonai haomer elay shuv vegomer, iatar veikshar kishshura bekishshura chad kedka chaze. elohe avi avraham limina, vilohe avi yitzchak lismala. haomer elay, hacha tale milla leitattera leatreh benayyhu. shuv leartzecha ulemoladtecha veetiva immach:

Katonti mikkol hachasadim, ammay hava itzterich hay im hay. ella amar yaakov at avtacht li leotava immi, veana yedana dechol ovadach kullehu al tenay. ha ana let bi zechuta deha katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet asher asita et avdecha, vechol ma daavadat li ad yoma lav begin zechutay hava ella beginach hu daavadat li, vehahu tivu ukeshot beginach hava. deha kad avarna bekadmita dehavena azil mikkamme deesav, yechiday avarna leh lehahu nahara, veant avdit immi tivu ukeshot. veha ana hasheta maavar leh bitre mashshiryayn, inun teren mashshiryayn defalig.

Ad hacha siddura deshivcha demareh, mikkan ulehala baa ma deitzterich leh. leachazaa lechol beni alma, deitzterich leh levar nash lesaddera shevacha demareh bekadmita, ulevatar yibbae bauteh. dehachi avad yaakov, bekadmita sidder shevacha demareh, ulevatar desidder shevacha amar bauteh deitzterich leh.

Hada hu dichtiv hatztzileni na miyyad achi miyyad esav ki yare anochi oto pen yavo vehikkanni em al banim. mikkan, man detzalle tzeloteh devae lefarsha milloy kedka yeut. hatztzileni na, vei tema deha shezavt li millavan. miyyad achi. vei tema kerivin ocharanin setam, achin ikrun. miyyad esav. may taama, begin lefarsha milla kedka yeut. vei tema ana ammay itzterich, ki yare anochi oto pen yavo vehikkani. begin leishtemoda milla leela ulefarsha lah kedka yeut, vela yastim milla:
Veatta amarta hetev etiv immach vegomer. veatta amarta hetev etiv, may veatta. kema deat amer (Nechemya 9:6) veatta mechayye et kullam, uf hacha veatta amarta.

Ta chaze, david malka amar (Tehillim 19:15) yihyu leratzon imre fi, illen millin deitparshan. vehegyon libbi, illen millin distiman dela yachil bar nash lefarsha lon befumeh, da hu hegyon deihu belibba dela yachil leitparsha.

Veal da itzterich milla leitparsha befuma, umilla detalya belibba, vecholla raza ihu. chad lokovel darga tattaa, vechad lokovel darga illaa. milla deitparsha lokovel darga tattaa deitzterich leitparsha. hahu detalya belibba ihu lokovel darga penimaa yattir, vecholla kechada ihu. veal da amar yihyu leratzon imre fi vehegyon libbi lefanecha vegomer.

Kegavvna da amar yaakov, bekadmita parish milla kedka yeut, ulevatar satim milla deihi talya behegyona delibba dela itzterich lefarsha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:13) vesamti et zaracha kechol hayyam asher lo yissafer merov. hacha ihu milla detalya belibba dela itzterich lefarsha. vechen itzterich kidkaamaran, begin leyachada yichuda shelim kedka yeut. zakkain inun tzaddikaya deyade lesaddera shevacha demarehon kedka yeut ulemive bautehon, uvegin kach ketiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar. (sefer acher ketiv gam et hashsheni gam et hashshelishi vegomer, hashshalosh peamim gam, ramaz 2 leshalosh geulot al yede shelosha tzaddikim moshe mardochay mashiach sheatid legoolenu bekeruv):
Vayyivvater yaakov levaddo vegomer. ribbi chiyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 91:10) lo teunne elecha raa venega lo yikrav beoholecha. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma avad bechol yoma veyoma
337: Avidteh deitchaze leh veha ukemuha. veittemar, (davar acher 33 vei tema) beyoma reviaa avad nehorin. ucheden itbere sihara chaser, nehora deazirat garmah, uvegin deihi meorot chaser vav, ityehiv ducheta leshalletaa kol ruchin veshedin veilulin umazzikin vechol ruche mesaave.

Kullehu salkin veshatin bealma leastaa, veitmannun beduchete deitcharivu, uvechaklin takkifin uvemadberin charivin. vechullehu missitre ruach mesaava. veha ittemar deha ruach mesaava deatya minnachash akimaa ihu ruach mesaava mammash. veihu itmanna bealma leastaa bar nash legabbeh, veal da yetzer hara shallit bealma.

Veihu itmanne legabbayyhu divni nasha veishtakkach immehon. uvaakimu uvetaskufin ate legabbayyhu leastaa lon mearchoy kudesha berich hu, kema deaste leadam kadmaa vegarim mota lechol alma, hachi name aste lehu livne nasha vegarim lon leistaava.
Uman deate leistaava ihu mashich aleh hahu ruach mesaava veitdabbek bahadeh, vechamma inun dizminin lesaava leh umesaavin leh, veihu mesaav, vesoovin leh behay alma uvehahu alma veha ittemar.

Uveshaata deate bar nash leitdachaa, hahu ruach mesaava itkafyay kammeh vela yachil leshaltaa aloy, ucheden ketiv, (Tehillim 91:10) lo teunne elecha raa venega lo yikrav beoholecha. amar (sefer acher kidamar) rabbi yose lo teunne elecha raa, da lilit, venga lo yikrav veoholecha, illen shear mazzikin, veha ukemuha veittemar.

Ribbi elazar amar ha amaran dela yippuk bar nash yechidaa belelya, vechol shekken bezimna desihara itberiat vehava (vehi) chasera, veukemuha. deha keden rucha mesaava shalta, veda hu ruach raa, man raa, da chivya visha. venga, da hu man derachiv al chivya. raa venega kechada inun.

Veaf al gav detaninan, denga, illen nige bene adam denafku meadam. deha kol inun shenin dela kariv adam im itteteh, ruche mesaave havu ka atyayn umitchamman minneh veolidan minneh vehanne ikrun nige bene adam.

Veha ittemar, dechad bar nash bechelmeh vela shallit begufeh vegufa ishtakkach, ruach mesaava atyay vesharya aleh. veit zimnin deruche nukevin mesaavin atyayn vekarvan bahadeh, umashchin leh bahadayyhu umitchamman minneh, veolidu levatar ruchin umazzikin (nige bene adam nusach acher kegavvna bene nasha). ulezimnin itchazyayn kechezu bene nasha bar delet lon saare beresha.

Uvecholla it leh levar nash leistammera mikkammayyhu, begin dihach bearche deorayyta vela yistaav bahadayyhu. deha let lach man denaim belelya bearseh, dela taim tama demota venafkat nishmateh minneh. vechevan deishtaar gufa bela nishmata kaddisha, ruach mesaava zammin vesharya aleh veistaav. veha okimna milla, delet leh levar nash leaavara yedoy al enoy betzafra. begin deha rucha mesaava sharya alayyhu vechulei veha ittemar.
Ta chaze, deha yaakov af al gav deitrachim kammeh kudesha berich hu, begin deishtaar bilchodoy, rucha ochora hava zamin leizdavvevga bahadeh.

Ribbi shimon amar, ta chaze, ma ketiv beh behahu rasha devilam, vayyelech shefi, mahu shefi, yechiday. kema deat amer shefifon ale orach, kehay chivya deazil yechiday vechamin ale archin ushevilin. hachi name bilam hava azil yechiday. may tama begin leamshacha aleh rucha mesaava. dechol man deazil yechiday bizmannin yedian, afillu bemata, beatrin yedian. mashich aleh rucha mesaava.

Vegin kach, bechol zimna la yehach bar nash yechiday bearcha vemata ella beatar divne nasha azlin vetavin umishtakkechin tamman, veal da la yehach bar nash yechiday belelya hoil uvene nasha la mishtakkeche, vehayeynu tama dela talin nivlato.
338: Dela lekayyma gufa mita bela rucha al ara belelya. begin kach hahu rasha devilam hava azil yechiday kehay nachash kema deukemuha.

Vayyeavek ish immo, may vayyeavek. (gillayon deamar rabbi Yehoshua ben levi, melammed desaliku avak baregaleyhevan ad kurese yikkare. ketiv hacha beheavko immo, uchetiv 0 avak raglav, vehahu malach sharu shel asu haya, veihu samael. begin kach, dino hu sheyyaale avak daregaleyv ad kisse hakkavod, shehu makom hammishpat). ribbi shimon amar min avak. avak tafel leafar, ma ben afar leavak. da avak deishtaar min nura vela avad ibbin (bealma) lealmin. afar dechol ibbin nafke minneh veihu kelala beela vetatta.

Amar ribbi yehuda i hachi may (Shmuel 1 2:8) mekim meafar dal. amar leh kemashmao, aval behay gavvna mekim meafar dal, begin delet leh miggarmeh kelum, umehahu afra nafak dal delet leh kelum, umehahu afar kol ibbin vechol tivu dealma nafke minneh. uveh itavidu kol ovadin dealma kema dichtiv, (Kohelet 3:20) hakkol haya min heafar vehakkol shav el heafar. vetaninan hakkol haya min heafar veafillu galgal chamma. aval avak la avid perin veibbin (lealma) lealmin, uvegin kach vayyeavek ish, deatya behahu avak urechiv aleh, begin lekatrega leh leyaakov.

Ad alot hashshachar, deitavar shuletanuteh veitchallaf. vechach hu lezimna deate, begin degaluta hasheta kelelya damya, veihu lelya. veshalta hahu avak al yisrael veinun shechive leafra (ochara), ad deyistallak nehora veyitnehar yemama. ucheden yishletun yisrael ulehon yityahiv malchuta deinun kaddishe elyonin. kema deat amer, (Daniel 7:27) umalchuta veshaltana urevuta di malchevat techot kol shemaya yehivat leam kaddishe elyonin malchute malchut alam vechol shaltanaya le yiflechun veyishtammeun:

Vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 6:10) mi zot hannishkafa kemo shachar yafa challevana bara kachamma ayumma kannidgalot. hay kera ukemuha veittemar, aval mi zot hannishkafa, illen inun yisrael bezimna dekudesha berich hu yokim lon veyafik lon min galuta. keden yiftach lon pitcha dinhora (dehi) dakkik zeer. ulevatar pitcha acharina deihu rav mineh, ad dekudesha berich hu yiftach lon tarin illain petichin learba ruche alma.

Vechen kol ma deavid kudesha berich hu leyisrael uletzaddikayay di behu, hachi kullehu velav bezimna chada. levar nash deityehiv bachashocha vediyyureh hava bachashocha tadir, kad yivun leanhara leh, bayayn leiftecha leh nehora zeerta keena demachata, ulevatar rav minneh, ucheden bechol zimna ad deyinharun leh kol nehora kedka yeut.

Kacha inun yisrael kema deat amer, (Shemot 23:30) meat meat a gorashennu mippanecha ad asher tifre vegomer. vechen leman deate asvavta lav ihu beshata chada, ella zeer zeer ad deyittakkaf. aval leesav lav hachi, ella bezimna chada nahir leh veitavid minneh zeer zeer. (ulezimna deate laummot ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot 1 Adonai kagibbor yatza) ad deyittakfun yisrael vishetzun (vayshabevan) leh mikkolla, mealma den umealma deate. uvegin denahir beshata chada, hava leh shetziu mikkolla. aval yisrael nehora dilhon zeer zeer, ad deyittakfun veyanhir lon kudesha berich hu lealmin.

Vecholla shaale lon veamre mi zot hannishkafa kemo shachar, ihu kadruta detzafra, veda ihu nehora dakik. ulevatar yafa challevana, begin desihara nehora dilah nahir yattir mishshachar. ulevatar bara kachamma, begin dinhoreh takkif venahir yattir missihara. ulevatar ayumma kannidgalot, takkifa binhora takkif kedka yeut.

Ta chaze, beod deitchashach yemama veitkasya nehora veate tzafra, yitnehir bekadmita zeer zeer ad deyitrabbe nehora kedka yeut. deha kevan dekudesha berich hu yitar leanhara lah lichneset yisrael, yitnehir bekadmita kemo shachar deihi uchema. ulevatar yafa challevana, ulevatar bara kachamma. ulevatar ayumma kannidgalot kema deittemar.
339: Veta chaze, kevan deistalik tzafra, deha la ketiv ki va hashshachar ella ki ala, deha bezimna ki va hashshachar, keden ittakkaf hahu memanna veakkish leh leyaakov. begin dehahu memanna akkish leyaakov lemehav takkifu leitattakkafa leesav.

Vechad salik hahu uchema deshachar veitchaze ata nehora veittakkaf yaakov, deha cheden mata zimneh leitnehara, ma ketiv vayyizrach lo hashshemesh kaasher avar et penuel vehu tzolea al yerecho. vayyizrach lo hashshemesh, deha keden zimna leitnahara.

Vehu tzolea al yerecho. keden ihu remez deha beod deyisrael begaluta vesavlin keevin vetzaarin vechamma bishin, kad itnehir lon yemama veyete lon nayycha, keden yistakkelun veyichavun begarmayyhu mikkamma bishin vetzaarin desavlu veyitmehu alayyhu. begin kach vayyizrach lo hashshemesh. dehahu zimna denayycha, ucheden vehu tzolea al yerecho itkaav vetzaer garmeh al ma deavar.

Veihu kad istallak kadruta deshachara keden ittakkaf veitachid beh dechad itchallash cheleh, delet leh shuletanuta ella belelya, veyaakov shaltanuteh bimama. veal da amar vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar, deha ana birshutecha kaimna, veha ittemar veukemuha:

(Al ken lo yochlu bene yisrael et gid hannashe vegomer, ki naga bechaf yarech yaakov, baggid hannashe, deafillu bahanaa asir vaafillu layhabeyh lechalba. veammay ikre gid hannashe. kelomar gid deihu menashshe livne nasha lefulechana demarehon, vetamman hu yetzer hara revia.

Kevan deitdabbak im yaakov lo ashkach atar deyachil leitgabbera aleh deyaakov, begin dechol shayyfe gufa sayyay leyaakov, vechullehu havo takkifin velo havo behon chulesha, ma eved, vayyigga bechaf yerecho baggid hannashe, bezineh beyetzer hara deihu zineh vaatareyh, umittamman ate yetzer hara al bene nasha.

Uvegin kach amra orayyta lo yochlu bene yisrael et gid hannashe. kema deamru chavrayyay, beshayyfin davar nash daremayz leella i tav, tav. vei bish, bish. uvegin kach kol shayyfa matkef shayyfa. vadday gid hannashe matkef leyetzer hara dehu zineh, uvene yisrael lo yochlu leh, delav inun missitreh vamezaynayh. aval ammin ovde avoda zara, yochlu leh, deihu missitra vamezaynaa demalacha dilhon deihu 131 begin letakafa libbehon.
Begin deit bevar nash 248 shayyfin lekabbel 248 pikkudin deorayyta deinnun lemebad ityehivu, velokovel 248 malachin deitlabbeshat behon shechinta veshemma dilhon kashemaa demarehon.

Veit bevar nash 365 gidin valekabelahevan 365 pikkudin delav inun ityehivu lemebad velokovel 365 yome shatta, veha tisha beav chad minnehon deihu lekabbel 131 deihu chad meinnun 365 malachin (nusach acher yomin), uvegin kach amra orayyta lo yochlu bene yisrael et gid hannashe. 401, leasgaa tisha beav dela ochalin beh vela shittin.

Uvegin kach chaza kudesha berich hu kelo venirmaz behon ramaz leyaakov, vayyeavek ish immo, bechol yome shatta uvechol shayyfin deyaakov velo ashkach bar hahu gid hannashe, miyyad tashash cheleh deyaakov, uveyome shatta ashkach yom tisha beav deveh ittakkaf veitgezar dina alana veitcharav bi makdesha, vechol man deachil betisha beav keillu achil gid hannashe). rabbi chiyyay amar, illemale la itchallash chela (nusach acher daatar) da deyaakov, itkeyyaym yaakov legabbeh veitbar chela deesav leela vetatta.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Yechezkel 1:28) kemare hakkeshet asher yihye beanan beyom haggeshem ken mare hannoga saviv hu mare demut kevod Adonai vaere vaeppol al panay vegomer. hay kera ittemar. aval ta chaze, deha ketiv, (Devarim la) velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe. ma ben moshe lishar nevie alma. moshe istakkal beaspaklarya denahara, shear nevie la havu mistakkele ella beaspaklarya
340: Dela nahara. moshe hava shama vekaim al ragloy, vecheleh ittakkaf, vehava yada milla al bureyeh, kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:8) umare velo vechidot. shear nevie havu nafle al anpayyhu veitchallash chela dilhon vela havu yachle lekayyma al bureyeh demilla. man garam lon da begin dichtiv ki naga bechaf yerech yaakov vehu tzolea al yerecho.

Vechol inun neviin la yachilu lekayyma al ma dezammin kudesha berich hu lemebad leh leesav, bar ovadya nevia dehava giyyora deate missitra deesav, da kaim bekiyyumeh aleh deesav vela itchallash cheleh. veal da kol shear nevie itchallash tukefayyhu vela havu yachlin leitkayyma lekabbela milla al bureyeh kedka yeut, may tama, begin ki naga bechaf yerech yaakov begin hannashe, denassiv veshaiv kol chela deyarcha, veal da itbar chela deyarcha veishtaar tzolea al yerecho. deha kol neviin dealma la yachilu leiddabbeka ulekayyma beh.

Ta chaze, neviin kullehu bar moshe la kayymu betukefayyhu kedka chaze. uman delae beorayyta velet man desamich leh vela ishtechach man deattil melay lechiseh leittakfa. al da orayyta ka mishtakkecha bechol dara vedara veitchallash tukefa deorayyta kol yoma veyoma, begin delet lon leinun delaan bah al ma desamchin, umalchu chayyayva ittakkaf bechol yoma veyoma. ta chaze,
Kamma garim chova da, uvegin delet (lon) man deasmich leorayyta kedka yeut inun samchin challashin, vegarmin leittakfa lehahu delet leh shokin veraglin lekayyma alayyhu.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 3:14) vayyomer Adonai elohim el hannachash ki asita zot arur atta mikkol habbehema vegomer al gechoncha telech. may al gechoncha telech. deittavru samchin dileh uketzitzu ragloy velet leh al ma dekaim. kad yisrael la baan lesamcha leh leorayyta, inun yahavin leh samchin veshokin lekayyma uleittakkefa behu.

Ta chaze, kamma akimu vechakkimu itchakkam behahu lelya hahu derachiv nachash lekovleh deyaakov, deha ihu hava yada dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:22) hakkol kol yaakov vehayyadayim yede esav. vei pasik kala deyaakov keden vehayyadayim yede esav. begin kach istakkal lechol sitrin leavasha leh leyaakov uleafsaka kaleh.

Vechama leh takkif becholla. deroin missitra da umissitra da deinun takifin gufa deittakkaf benayyhu, vechama tukefa deorayyta veittakkaf becholla, kede vayyar ki lo yachol lo. ma avad, miyyad vayyigga bechaf yerecho, deitchakkam lekovleh. amar kevan deittevaru samchin deorayyta, miyyad orayyta la ittakkaf. ucheden yitkayyaym ma deamar avuhon, hakkol kol yaakov vehayyadayim yede esav. (Bereshit 27:40) vehaya kaasher tarid ufarakta ullo meal tzavvarecha.

Uveda itchakkam lekovleh deyaakov deha begin deyittavar chela deorayyta azil veittakkaf esav. vechad chama dela yachil lah leorayyta, keden chalish tukefa deinun desamchin lah, vechad la yishtakkach man desamich leorayyta, keden la yehe kol kol yaakov vihon yadayim yede esav.

Vechad chama yaakov hachi kad salik tzafra, atkif (yaakov) beh veitgabbar aleh ad deihu berich leh veode leh al inun birchan, veamar leh lo yaakov yeamer od shimcha ki im yisrael, lav yaakov beakimu ella beguta vetukefa delet man deyachil lach.

Veta chaze, mehay nachash kamma chelin mitparshan lechol setar veishtakkachu bealma legabbe bene nasha. uveinan lekayyma lehahu gid hannashe, deaf al gav dekariv beh hahu derachiv al chivya kayyaym ihu, veitkeyyaym begavvavn vela ittebar.
Vechela beinan leittakkafa bealma uleachazaa ki sarita im elohim veim anashim vattuchol. vechad chame deha la ittebar vela itachil hahu atar, keden itbar cheleh vetukefeh
341: Vela yachil leavasha livnoy deyaakov. veal da la beinan lemehav ducheta livriyyayta dealma lemechal leh vela leitachala kelal.

Rabbi yesa sava darash, ki naga bechaf yerech yaakov. ketiv hacha ki naga bechaf, uchetiv hatam (Bamidbar 19:13) kol hannogea bemet benefesh haadam (yitma) vegomer. ma lehallan mesaava uf hacha name mesaava, desaiv hahu atar, umeatar mesaava let lan (leittakna) leithanaa minneh kelal, kol shekken beatar dekariv hahu setar mesaava, veorayyta la kaamar ella ki naga, uchetiv vayyigga bechaf yerecho, kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 19:22) vechol asher yigga bo hattame yitma, berich rachamana deyahiv orayyta leyisrael lemizke vah bealma den uvealma deate kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:16) orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod:

Vehu avar lifnehem vayyishtachu artza sheva peamim ad gishto ad achiv. rabbi elazar patach veamar, (Shemot la) ki lo tishtachave leel acher ki Adonai kanna shemo. vechi yaakov deihu shelema deavahan deitberir chulaka shelemata lekudesha berich hu veihu itkeriv legabbeh yattir, (sefer acher veishtelim leella uletatta) hech sagid leh lehahu rasha deesav deihu besitra deel acher, uman desagid leh sagid leel acher. i tema begin deamru tala beidaneh sagid leh, lav hachi. deha esav keel acher hava, veyaakov lo yisgod lehahu sitra ulehahu chulaka kelal.

(Patach rabbi abba veamar) ela ketiv, (Shmuel 1 25:6) vaamartem ko lechay veatta shalom uvetcha shalom vechol asher lecha shalom. veha ittemar deasir (davar acher 33 leh) leakdume lehu shelam lerashshiaya, vechevan deasir hechi ashkachna dedavid amar hay kera lenaval, ella ha ukemuha (Shemot 23 2) dilkudesha berich hu kaamar, begin lekashra leh lechay. vechashiv naval dealeh kaamar.

Kegavvna da (Bereshit 12) vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta, vechi legabbe divreh segid. ella leatreh dishchinta ka kara vesagid, uf hacha, vehu avar lifnehem. may vehu, da shechinta illaa dehava azla kammeh (kara), veda hu netiru illaa. kevan dechama yaakov, amar, ha idan lesagda legabbeh dekudesha berich hu dehava azil kammeh.

Kara vesagid sheva zimnin ad gishto ad achiv, vela ketiv vayyishtachu leesav. ella kevan dechama deha kudesha berich hu azal kammeh, keden sagid lekovleh. begin dela lemehav yekar lemisgad leochora bar minnih, vecholla ihu kedka yeut. zakkain inun tzaddikayay dechol ovadehon deka avde begin yekara demarehon ihu, uvegin dela yistun limina velismala:

Vayyaratz esav likrato vaychabbekehu vayyippol al tzavvarav. tzavvaro ketiv chaser. vayyishshakehu vayyivku. rabbi yitzchak amar (Yeshayahu 57:20) veharshaim kayyam nigrash ki hasheket lo yuchal vayyigreshu memav refesh vatit, hay kera ittemar. umille deorayyta, kamma razin illain it behu meshanyayn da min da, vecholla chad.

Veharshaim kayyam nigrash ki hasheket lo yuchol, da esav dechol ovadoy birshiu uvechiyyuva, deha kad ata legabbeh deyaakov, ovadoy la havu bishlam, vayyippol al tzavvarav, chad. tzavvaro da yerushala 40 deihu tzavvaro dechol alma. vayyippol al tzavvaro, velo al tzavvarav. begin ditren zimnin itchariv be makdesha. chad mibbavel, vechad mizzareh deesav, deappil garmeh aleh zimna chada vechariv leh. veal da vayyippol al tzavvaro chad.
