Vayyishshakehu, nakud leel, dela nashkeh biruteh. utenan may dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:6) venetarot neshikot sone, da bilam kad barich lon leyisrael. deha la barich lon biruta delibba. uf hacha netarot neshikot sone, da esav.

Amar ribbi yose, ketiv (Tehillim 3:8) kuma Adonai hoshieni elohay ki hikkita et kol oyvay lechi shinne reshaim shibbarta. utenan al tikre shibbarta ella shirbavta. deha asgiu shinoy vechashiv lenashcha leh vechulei. veal da vayyivku, da bache veda bache, veukemuha chavrayay.
342: Libbeh ureuteh deesav legabbe deyaakov, deha afillu behahu shata chashiv leorech zimnin (sefer acher laavarekaa deyomin) lemebad leh bishin ulekatrega leh, veal da vayyivku. da hava bache, dela hava chashiv leishtezava min yedoy. veda hava bache, begin deavoy hava kayyaym vela yachil leh.

Amar ribbi abba vadday itchallash rugezeh deesav beshata dechama leh leyaakov. may tama, begin deha istakkam bahadeh hahu memanna deesav. veal da la yachil esav leshaltaa berugezeh, dehachi kol millin dehay alma talyayn leela. vechad istakkemu leela bekadmita istakkemu letatta. shaltanuta lav ihu letatta ad deityahiv shaltanuta leela, vecholla da beda talya:

Yaavar na adoni lifne avdo vaani etnahala leitti vegomer. amar ribbi elazar, hayeynu dekaamrinan bekadmita deyaakov la baa hasheta inun birchan kadmay devarcheh avoy. (sefer acher begin dichtiv, 0 tov ligvar ki yissa al binurav. uchetiv 1 vattischak leyom acharon) vaadayin la itkayymu beh afillu chad minnayyhu. begin desalik lon lesof yomaya beshata deitzterichu livnoy legabbe kol ammin dealma.

Uvegin kach beshata deamar esav nisa venelecha, veniflug hay alma kechada venishlot kechada. ma amar, yaavar na adoni lifne avdo. yakdim esav shaltaneh hasheta behay alma. yaavar na, kema deat amer, (Micha 2:13) vayyaavor malkam lifnehem vaAdonai berosham, akdim ant shuletanutach bekadmita behay alma, vaani etnahala leitti. ana asallek garmi lehahu alma deate ulesof yomaya leinun yomaya deazlin leat.

Leregel hamelacha, man melacha. da aspaklarya dela nahara devah itavid avidta dealma. asher lifne, da hi min kodam Adonai bechol atar. uleregel hayeladim, da hu raza dichruvim, leachazaa raza dimhemnuta deihu itdabbak behu.

Ad asher avo el adoni seira, ana esbol galuta dilach ad deyete veyimte zimna dili leshaltaa al har esav, kema deat amer, (Ovadya 1:21) vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav, ucheden vehayta laAdonai hamelucha:

Veyaakov nasa sukkota vayyiven lo bayit ulemiknehu asa sukkot al ken kara shem hammakom sukkot. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 127:1) shir hammaalot lishlomo im Adonai lo yivne bayit vegomer, im Adonai lo yishmar ir vegomer. ta chaze, beshata desalik biruta dekudesha berich hu lemivre alma, appik (15 1) mibbutzina dekardinuta chad kittura, veitlehit miggo chashocha, veishtaar bisliku. venachata letatta, hahi chashecha lahit (vaatalehayt) bemea shevilin orchin dekikin ravrevan, veitavid beta dealma.

Hay beta ihu go emtzaita decholla, kamma pitchin veidrin leh sechor sechor, duchetin illain kaddishin, tamman mekanne tzippore shemaya, kol chad vechad lezineh. begavvevy nafik chad ilana ravreva vetakkif afyeh veinbeh sagge, mezona lecholla beh. hahu ilana salik laanane shemaya veittammar ben telat turin, mittechot illen telat turin nafik, salik leela nachit letatta.

Hay beta itshakyay minneh, veganiz begavvevy kamma ginzin illain dela ityedau, beda itbene hay beta veishtachlal hahu ilana itgalleyay bimama, veitkasseya belelya, vehay beta shalta belelya veitkasseya bimama.

Beshata deal chashocha veitkattir beh shalta, vechol pitchin setimin mikkol sitrin, keden kamma ruchin parchin baavira, teivin leminda ulemeal beh, vealin ben inun tzipporin, venatlin sahaduta, veshatyayn vechaman ma dechaman.

Ad deitar hahu chashocha deitkattir beh, veappik chad shalhova uvatash bechol pattishin takkifin, ufetach pitchin, uvaka tinnarin. salka venachata hahu shalhova, uvatash bealma, veitar kalin leela vetatta.
343: Karoza salik, veitkattir baavira, vekare, hahu avira nafka miggo ammuda daanana demadbecha penimaa, vechad nafka itpashshat bearba sitre alma. elef alfin kayymin missitra deihu semala, veribbo rivvavn kayymin missitra deihu yamina, vecharoza kaim bekiyyumeh. kare vechayil veachriz, keden kamma inun dimtakkeni shirata ufalchin pulechana, uteren pitchin petichu. chad listar daroma, vechad listar tzafon.

Salka hay veta veityehivat veitkatterat ben teren sitrin, veshirin mezammeran vetushebchan salkin. keden al man deal bilchisha, uveta mitlahata beshit nehorin, naharin ziva lechol setar, venaharin devusema nafkin. veitshakyayn kol chevat bera, kema deat amer (Tehillim 104:11) yashku kol chayto saday yishberu feraim tzemaam vegomer. vezamrin ad desalka tzafra. vechad salka tzafra keden kochvaya umazzale shemaya vechelehon kullehon meshabbechan veamre shirata, kema deat amer, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol bene elohim.

Ta chaze (Tehillim 127:1) im Adonai lo yivne vayit shav amlu vonav bo. im Adonai lo yishmar ir shav shakad shomer. im Adonai vegomer da malka illaa, deihu bone lehay beta tadir veatkin leh, ematay, kad salkin reutin pulechanin mittatta kedka yeut.

Im Adonai lo yishmar ir, ematay, beshata deitchashcha lelya, vesitrin mezayynin sharan veshatan bealma, ufitchin setimin, veitnetir mikkol sitrin dela yikrav beh arel umesaava, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 52:1) lo yosif yavo vach od arel vetame, dezammin kudesha berich hu leaavara lon mealma.

Man arel uman tame. ela kolla chad, arel vetame. da hu deitpatta beh veazil avatreh adam veinteteh, vegarimu mota lechol alma. veihu demasiv hay beta, ad hahu zimna deyaavar leh kudesha berich hu mealma. vegin kach im Adonai lo yishmar ir, shav vadday.

Ta chaze, veyaakov nasa sukkota, itnetil lekovla chulakeh dimhemnuta. ma ketiv leela, vayyashav bayyom hahu esav ledarko seira, uchetiv veyaakov nasa sukkota. ella kol chad itperash lesitra dileh, esav lesitra deseir. man seir, da hi ishsha zara el nichar. veyaakov nasa sukkota, da mehemnuta illaa.
Vayyiven lo vayit, kema deat amer, (yeshaya 2) bet yaakov. amar ribbi elazar, deatkin tefillat arvit kedka yeut. ulemiknihu asa sukkot, shear sukkot lenatra lon veda hu chulakeh.

Ucheden vayyavo yaakov shalem. shalem mikkolla veukemuha. uchetiv, (Tehillim 76:3) vayhi veshalem sukko vegomer veukemuha, vecholla raza chada. keden itchabber immeh mehemnuta kad hava shelim kad itatar beducheteh deitchaze leh. ucheden hay sukka itatterat bahadeh, dehava shelim meavahan, dehava shelim mibbenoy, veda hu shalem. shalem leela shalem letatta, shalem bishmaya shalem beara. shalem leela deihu kelala deavahan, tiferet yisrael. shalem letatta bivnoy kaddishin. shelim bishmaya, shelim beara, ucheden vayhi veshalem sukko veukemuha. miyyad ma ketiv vatetze dina vat lea, veukemuha chavrayay.
Ta chaze, kamma dargin vesitrin mitparshan leela vechullehu meshanyayn da min da. chevavn meshanyayn illen meillen, illen mekatregin leshalletaa al illen ulemitraf tarfin kol chad vechad lezineh.

Missitra derucha mesaava kamma dargin mitparshin, vechullehu kaman lekatrega illen lokovel illen, deha ketiv (Devarim 22:10) lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav, dechad ka mitchabberan mekatrege alma.

Veta chaze, tiuveta dedargin mesaavin lav ihu ella lekatrega besitrin kaddishin. yaakov deihu kaddisha, kullehu kaman leh vekitregu bahadeh. bekadmita nashcheh chivya, kema deat amer vayyigga bechaf yuricho, hasheta nashcheh chamor.
Tamman ihu kaim legabbe chivya, hasheta shimon velevi deatu missitra
344: Dedina kashya kayymu legabbeh dechamor veshallitu aloy bechol sitrin veitkafya kammayyhu. kema deat amer veet chamor veet shechem beno hargu lefi charev. veshimon dehava (shor) mazzaleh (ihu) shor, ata al chamor vekitreg beh, begin dela yitchabberun kechada, veishtakkach ihu mekatrega dileh.

Vechullehu ate lekatrega leh leyaakov veishteziv, ulevatar ihu shallit alayyhu. levatar ata shor veishtalim bachamorim dechullehu missitra dechamor. yosef deihu shor, umitzrayim deinun chamorim dichtiv behu (Yechezkel 23:20) asher besar chamorim besaram.

Veal da levatar bene yaakov naflu ben inun chamorim, begin deizdavvavg shor bahadayyhu, venashchu lon garmayay uvisra. ad deitar levi kemilkaddemin uvaddar leinun chamorim (sefer acher daazadevavegav) lechafya lon vetavar tukefehon mealma, veappik leshor mittamman. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 13:19) vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo.

Ta chaze, kad ata shimon bekadmita al hahu chamor, itar alehon dam deitgazzaru, ulevatar vayyahargu kol zachar. kegavvna da avad kudesha berich hu al yeda delevi, da moshe. beinun chamorim bemitzrayim. bekadmita dam, ulevatar (Shemot 13:15) vayyaharog Adonai kol bechor beeretz mitzrayim vegomer. hacha behay chamor ketiv, veet kol chelam veet kol tappam veet kol behemtam vegomer. hatam beinun chamorim ketiv, (Shemot 12:35) kele chesef uchele zahav usemalot, uchetiv, (Shemot 12:38) vegam erev rav ala ittam vetzon uvakar vegomer.

Veshimon velevi, da kaim legabbe hay chamor, veda kaim legabbe kol inun chamorim, kullehu bau leishtattefa bahadeh deyaakov kaddisha veittakkenu lenashcha leh, veihu bivnoy kaim legabbayyhu vechayyif lon techoteh.
Hasheta deesav nashich leh velivnoy, man yakum legabbeh, yaakov veyosef. da missitra da veda missitra da. dichtiv, (Ovadya 1:18) vehaya bet yaakov esh uvet yosef lehava uvet esav lekash vegomer:

Vayyissau vayhi chittat elohim al hearim asher sevivotehem velo radfu achare bene yaakov. amar ribbi yose kullehu havu mitkanneshe, vechad havu chagre zayyne kerava havu merattete veshavkin lon, uvegin kach velo radfu achari bene yaakov:

Hasiru et elohe hannechar vegomer. hasiru et elohe hannechar, illen inun denatlu mishshechem mane kaspa vedahava dehava chakik alayyhu taava dilhon. ribbi yehuda amar, taavavn havu mikkaspa vedahava. veyaakov atmin lon tamman, begin dela yithannun missitra deavoda zara, deasir leh levar nash leithanne minneh lealmin.

Ribbi yehuda veribbi chizkiyya havu azle bearcha, amar ribbi chizkiyya leribbi yehuda, may dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 12:30) vayyikkach et ateret malkam meal rosho umishkalah kikkar zahav veeven yekara vattehi al rosh david. vetaninan, shikkutz bene ammon milkom shemeh. veda hu ateret malkam. may taama vattehi al rosh david. umay tama ketiv shikkutz. deha bishar taavavn ammemaya ovde avoda zara ketiv elohe haammim, elohim acherim, el nechar, el acher, uvehay amar shikkutz chad.

Amar leh, uvechol taavavn ammemayay ovde avoda zara hachi kara lon kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Devarim 23) vattiru et shikkutzehem veet gillulehem. uma deamar vayyikkach et ateret malkam, deihu milkom, hachi hu vadday. ella ittay haggitti ad dela itgeyyayr, keden ihu tavar lah lehahu ateret deihu milkom, hahu diukena dechakik alah ufagim lah. keden ihu avad lah hetter leithanne minnah vehavat al resheh. veta chaze, shikkutz bene ammon, chad chivya besureta hava chakik al hahu kitra, uvegin kach ikre shikkutz zuhama.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, hasiru et elohe hannechar, illen shear nashin dehavu mayyte begavvayyhu kol nevazbezan dilhon. veal da ketiv vayyittenu el yaakov et kol elohe hannichar. illen nashin, kol nevazbezan vechol taavavn dedahava vechaspa. vayyitmon otam yaakov, begin dela
345: Ta chaze, deyaakov gevar shelim becholla hava, vehava mitdabbak beh bekudesha berich hu. ma ketiv, venakuma venaala bet el veeese sham mizbeach lael haone oti beyom tzarati vayhi immadi badderech asher halachti, miyyad vayyittenu el yaakov. mikkan devae bar nash leshabbacha lekudesha berich hu uleodaa leh al nissin veal tavan deavad immeh, hada hu dichtiv vayhi immadi badderech asher halachti.

Ta chaze, bekadmita ketiv venakuma venaale bet el vegomer, achlil benoy bahadeh. ulevatar ketiv veeese sham mizbeach vela ketiv venaase. deappik lon mikkelala da, may tama, begin dealeh hava milla. yaakov atkin tefillat arvit, vadday. veihu avad madbecha vealeh hava milla, uvegin deihu avar kol inun aktin min yoma dearak kammeh deachuha. dichtiv vayhi immadi badderech asher halachti, veinun atu levatar lealma. veal da la ail lon bahadeh.
Ribbi elazar amar, mikkan man deyitavid leh nissa, ihu bae leodaa. man deachil nahama befatora, ihu bae levarcha, vela ochora dela achil midi:

Vayyiven sham mizbeach vegomer, ta chaze, ketiv vayyiven sham mizbeach, vela ketiv (behane madbechan) deassik aleh nischin vealavavn, ella begin deatkin hahu darga deitchaze leittakkena. mizbeach laAdonai, leatkana darga tattaa lechabbera leh bedarga illaa, veal da vayyiven sham mizbeach da darga tattaa. laAdonai da darga illaa. vayyikra lammakom el bet el, shema da kishma illaa. begin dechad itnahara keden keimma bittah vecholla chad.

Ki sham niglu elav haelohim, begin deinun la ishtakkachu ella bishchinta, deha shivin havu deinun mishtakkeche tadir bahade shechinta, veshivin kattadrae sacharanih dishchinta. veal da ki sham niglu elav haelohim beatra da deitgalleya, deha ketiv vehinne Adonai nitztzav alav:

Vayyaal mealav elohim bammakom asher dibber itto, ribbi shimon amar, mikkan deitavid reticha kaddisha bahade avahan. veta chaze, yaakov ihu reticha kaddisha illaa dekayyma leanhara lesihara, veihu reticha bilchodoy. hada hu dichtiv vayyaal mealav elohim.

Patach veamar, (Devarim 4:7) ki mi goy gadol asher lo elohim kerovim elav kaAdonai elohenu bechol karenu elav. ta chaze, kamma inun chavivin yisrael kamme kudesha berich hu, delet lach am velishan bechol ammin ovde avoda zara dealma deit leh elaha deyishma lon, kema dekudesha berich hu zammin lekabbela tzelothon uvautehon deyisrael bechol shata deitzterich lon lemishma tzelota deinun baan, begin hahu darga dillehon.

Ta chaze, yaakov, kare leh kudesha berich hu, yisrael. dichtiv lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov ki im yisrael yihye shemecha. vayyikra et shemo, man vayyikra, da shechinta. kema deat amer vayyikra el moshe. vayyomer lo elohim.
Leel okimna yisrael deha ishtellim becholla kedka yeut, ucheden istallak bedargeh veishtelim bishma da, veal da vayyikra et shemo yisrael veha ittemar.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose havu azle bearcha, amar ribbi yose lerabbi elazar, vadday ha deamart deyaakov shelema deavahan ihu, veihu achid lechol sitrin, vekara shemeh yisrael, uchetiv lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov ki im yisrael yihye shemecha. uchetiv vayyikra et shemo yisrael. ammay ahadar kudesha berich hu vekara leh yaakov bechamma zimnin, vecholla karun leh yaakov kemillekaddemin. i hachi, mahu velo yikkare shimcha od yaakov.

Amar leh, shappir ka amart. patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 42:13) Adonai kaggibbor yetze keish milchamot yair kina, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, kaggibbor yetze, gibbor mibbae leh. keish milchamot, ish milchamot mibbae leh.
Ella ha ittemar Adonai bechol atar rachame ihu, vadday
346: Kudesha berich hu, Adonai shemeh ihu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:8) ani Adonai hu shemi, vechaminan dilzimnin itkere shemeh elohim vehu dina bechol atar. ella bezimna deasgiu zakkain bealma, Adonai shemeh veitkere bishma derachame. uvezimna deasgiu chayyayvin bealma, elohim shemeh veitkere bishma deelohim. kach bezimna deyaakov la hava ben sanin vela hava beara ochora, kare leh yisrael. vechad hava ben sanin, o beara ochora kare leh yaakov.

Amar leh, adayin la ityayshva milla. dichtiv lo yikkare, veha anan karinan leh. umay daamart dechad hava ben sanin o beara ochora kare leh yaakov. ta chaze, ketiv, (Bereshit 37:1) vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan, veha la hava beara ochora.

Amar leh, ha bekadmita ittemar, kema dekudesha berich hu lezimnin itkere Adonai, ulezimnin itkere elohim. hachi name lezimnin ikre yisrael ulezimnin ikre yaakov vecholla bedargin yedian. uma deittemar lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov, leityashsheva bishma da.

Amar leh, i hachi, ha ketiv, (Bereshit 17:5) velo yikkare od et shimcha avram vehaya shimcha avraham. amar leh, hatam ketiv vehaya. veal da kayyma behahu shema. aval hacha la ketiv vehaya, ella ki im yisrael yihye shemecha. vela ketiv vehaya shimcha yisrael, veafillu bezimna chada sagge leh, kol shekken dilzimnin kach ulezimnin kach. vechad itatteru benoy bechohane velevae veistalleku bedargin illain, keden itattar bishma da tadir.

Ad dehavu azle, amar leh ribbi yose leribbi elazar, ha ittemar dechad mitat rachel natla beta man deitzterich leittakkena bitresar shivtin kedka yeut. ammay mitat rachel miyyad, amar leh, ha lemeheve shechinta mitattera kedka yeut ulemeheve em habbanim semecha uveh sharya (leella) lenatla beta uleittakkana. veal da binyamin hu tadir bemaarav vela vesitra ochora.
Uveh sharya leittakkena bitresar shivtin, uveh sharya malchuta dirkia leishtemoda beara. veraza da, bechol sheruta deatya leishtemoda bekashyu ihu, veal da it bah dina demota umittamman ityashshevat.

Hacha kad baa leittakkena ulenatla beta itavid dina berachel uvatar ken ittakkenat leityashsheva. kad baa leishtemoda malchuta beara sharya bedina. vela ityashshevat malchuta beducheta kedka yeut ad deitar dina bishaul lefum ovadoy, ulevatar ityashshevat malchuta veittakkenat.

Ta chaze, kol sheruta takkif ulevatar nayycha. berosh hashshana sheruta takkif. dechol alma itdan kol chad vechad lefum ovadoy, ulevatar nayycha selicha vechippure. begin desheruta ihu mismala veal da dinoy takkifin, ulevatar itar yamina veal da have nayycha.

Ulezimna deate zammin kudesha berich hu leitara benayycha al shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, ulevatar yittakkaf alayyhu bedina kashya. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:13) Adonai kaggibbor yetze keish milchamot yair kina yaria af yatzriach al oyvav yitgabbar. Adonai bekadmita deihu rachame, ulevatar kaggibbor vela gibbor. ulevatar keish milchamot velo ish milchamot. levatar itgeli tukefa alayyhu veyittakkaf leshetzaa lon, dichtiv yaria af yatzriach al oyvav yitgabbar. uchetiv, (Zecharya 14:3) veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem keyom hillachamo beyom kerav. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 63:1) mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra vegomer:

Vayhi betzet nafshah ki meta vattikra shemo ben oni veaviv kara lo binyamin. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Nachum 1:7) tov Adonai lemaoz beyom tzara veyodea chose vo. zakkaa chulakeh devar nash deittakkaf beh bekudesha berich hu, begin detukefa dekudesha berich hu ihu tukefa, veukemuha tov Adonai, kema deat amer (Tehillim 145:9) tov Adonai lakkol. lemaoz, da hu tukefa deit beh yeshuot. dichtiv, (Tehillim 28:8) umaoz
347: Yeshuot meshicho hu. beyom tzara, beyoma deaku deakin shear ammin leyisrael.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv (Mishlei 24:10) hitrappita beyom tzara tzar kochecha. may hitrappita. man deitrappe yedoy mikudesha berich hu dela leittakkefa beh. vehech yitkaf var nash beh bekudesha berich hu, yatkif beorayyta. dechol man deittakkaf beorayyta, ittakkaf beilana dechayye. kivyachol yahav tukefa lichneset yisrael leittakfa.
Vei hu yitrappe meorayyta, ma ketiv hitrappita. i ihu itrappe min orayyta beyom tzara tzar kochecha, beyoma deyete leh aku, kivyachol dachik lah lishchinta deihu chela dealma.

Davar acher tzar kochecha, ta chaze, beshata devar nash itrappe meorayyta veazil bearcha dela chashra, kamma baale devavu zeminin leh limeheve leh kattegorin beyoma deaku. veafillu nishmateh devar nash deihu chela vetukefa dileh ihu mare devavu lekovleh, dichtiv tzar kochecha, begin deihu tzar legabbeh. amar ribbi abba beshata devar nash azil bearche deorayyta vechol archoy mittakkenan kedka yeut, kamma sanegorin kayymin aleh leadkara leh letav.

Patach veamar, (Iyov 33:23-24) im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef lehaggid leadam yashro vaychunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat matzati chofer. hanne kerae it leistakkala behu, vechi la itgeli kolla kame kudesha berich hu, deihu tzarich lemalcha deyema kammeh tav o vish.
Ella vadday itzterich. dechad it leh levar nash sannegorin leadkara zechu dideh kammeh, vela it leh (levar nash) kattegorin, keden vaychunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat matzati chofer.

Ta chaze, behay kera tishkach berira demilla, ketiv im yesh alav malach, i la ketiv yattir yaot hu. aval malach melitz echad minni alef ketiv, uman ihu. da hu malach dimmanna immeh devar nash bistar semala, dichtiv, (Tehillim 91:7) yippol mitztzidcha elef, veda hu sitra dismala, dichtiv batreh urevava miminecha.

Aval echad minni elef, da hu yetzer hara, deihu echad meinnun (deihu) elef dehavu listar semala. begin deihu salik leela venatil reshu. veal da i var nash azil beorach keshot, hahu yetzer hara ihu eved lo. kema deittemar dichtiv, (Mishlei 12:9) tov nikle veeved lo. keden ihu salik veitavid sannegora, veamar kamme kudesha berich hu, zechu aleh devar nash. keden kudesha berich hu amar, pedaehu meredet shachat.

Veim kol da la ahadar berekanya, begin deityehiv leh ochora leshaltaa aloy velittol nishmateh minneh. begin deakdim chovoy dehahu bar nash veihu kofer al hay. hada hu dichtiv matzati kofer, lemifde leh.

Davar acher matzati chofer. hahu zechu deamart ihu aleh kofer lemifde leh dela yechot laggehinnom vela yemut. veal da mibbae leh levar nash lemehach beorach keshot uvegin diyhe leh hahu kattegora, sannegora.

Kegavvna da yisrael beyoma dechippure, deyahave leh sair veitassiku bahadeh. ad deithadar eved lehu vesalik vesahid sahaduta kamme kudesha berich hu, veitavid lehu sannegora. veal da amar shelomo, (Mishlei 25:21) im raev sonaacha haachilehu lechem veim tzame hashekehu mayim. veal hay yetzer hara ittemar.

Uvegin da beyom tzara, kad var nash itrappe meorayyta, kivyachol dachik leh kudesha berich hu bahadeh dehahu yetzer hara deihu itavid kattegora. tzar kochecha. tzar koach ko, begin deitkarev kammeh lekatrega veitchallash chela.

Ta chaze, tov Adonai lemaoz beyom tzara, may beyom tzara. da yaakov kad ata aleh esav lekatrega leh. veyodea chose vo, kad ata aleh aku dedina. veta chaze, let mekatrega ishtakkach aleh devar nash ella bezimna desakkana.
Veta chaze, begin deyaakov achar nidreh denadir kamme kudesha berich hu, ittakkaf dina al yeda dimkatrega dekatrig aleh deyaakov,
348: Uvaa dina beshata desakkana dehavat rachel bah. amar kammeh kudesha berich hu, veha yaakov nadar nidreh vela shalim, veha ihu takkif mikkolla beutera uvivnin bechol ma deitzterich. vela shalim nidreh denadar kammach vela nasavt onasha minneh. miyyad vatteled rachel vattekash belidtah. may vattekash. deitkashshe dina leela gabbe malach hammavet.
Veitannash yaakov behay. may tama, begin dichtiv (Mishlei 22:27) veim en lecha leshallem lamma yikkach mishkavcha mittachtecha. veal da mitat rachel veitmasar dina al yeda demalach hammavet.

Veta chaze, beshata deata esav, ma avad. vayyasem et hashshefachot veet yaldehen rishona veet lea viladeha acharonim veet rachel veet yosef acharonim. may tama, begin dedachil ala derachel, dela yistakkal hahu rasha beshappiru dilah vela yekatreg leh alah.

Tu ma ketiv, vattiggashna hashefachot henna veyaldehen vattishtachavena vattiggash gam lea viladeha vayyishtachavu, nashin mikkamme guverin. aval berachel ma ketiv veachar niggash yosef verachel, veyosef mikkame immeh veihu chappa alah, veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 49:22) ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin. deasge gufeh vechappa al immeh. ale ayin, ale ena dehahu rasha.

Vehacha itanashat al yeda deyetzer hara dekitreg beshata desakkana, veitannash yaakov al nidra dela shalim, veda kashya leh leyaakov mikkol aku daavru aleh. umenalan divgineh deyaakov hava, dichtiv, (Bereshit 48:7) meta alay rachel. alay vadday, al deacharit nidri.

Ribbi yose amar, ketiv, (Mishlei 27) killelat chinnam lo tavo. veukemuha lo bevyv, dei killelat tzaddika hi, afillu dela itkavvan bah, kevan denafka mippumeh natal lah hahu yetzer hara vekitreg bah beshata desakkana.

Yaakov amar, (Bereshit 31:32) im asher timtza et elohecha lo yichye. veaf al gav deihu la hava yada, natil lah lehahi milla hahu satan deishtakkach gabbayyhu tadir bivni nasha. veal da taninan, leolam lo yiftach bar nash pumeh lesitna, begin denatil hahi milla vekitreg bah leela vetatta. kol shekken milla dechacham o milla detzaddika, veal teren illen itanashat rachel:

Vayhi (kanehab) betzet nafshah ki meta. amar ribbi abba vechi kevan deamar vayhi betzet nafshah la yedana ki meta. ela itzterich begin dela ahadarat legufa yattir, umitat rachel mitat gufa, begin deit beni nasha denafke nishmatayyhu veahadran leatrayyhu ukkema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 30) vattashav nafsho (lefanenu bakkera rucho. vabedapevas yerushalayim ita gam 120 vatteshev rucho elav) elav, (Bereshit 42:28) vayyetze libbam, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:6) nafshi yatza bedabbero. (Melachim 1 17:17) lo notra bo neshama. aval hay nafkat nishmatah vela ithaddarat leatrah umitat rachel.

Vattikra shemo ben oni. dekashyu dedina deitgezar alah. veyaakov ahadar leh vekashir leh leymina, begin demaarav itzterich lekashra leh limina, veaf al gav deihu ben oni sitra dedina kashya, ben yamin ihu, deha bimina itkashsherat.
Veitkevarat bearcha kema deittemar. hay itgalleya mitatah ukevuratah, aval lea la itgalleya mitatah ukevuratah. veaf al gav dehanne arba immahan raza it lon veha ukemuha:
Vayyatztzev yaakov matztzeva al kevuratah, amar ribbi yose, may tama. begin dela itkasya atrah ad yoma dezammin kudesha berich hu laachayay metayay. kema deittemar ad hayyom, ad hahu yoma mammash.

Ribbi yehuda amar, ad yoma detehdar shechinta begalutehon deyisrael behahu atar, kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 31:17) veyesh tik2vah leacharitech neum Adonai veshavu vanim ligvulam. veda omaa deome lah kudesha berich hu. uzeminin yisrael kad yetuvun min galuta, lekayyma al hahi kevura derachel ulemivke tamman. kema deihi bachat al galutehon deyisrael. veal da ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:9) bivchi yavou uvetachanunim ovilem vegomer. uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:9) ki yesh sachar lifulatech. uvehahi
349: Shata zeminat rachel deihi vearcha lemechede behu beyisrael veim shechinta veukemuha chavrayyay:

Vayhi bishkon yisrael baaretz hahi vayyelech reuven vayyishkav et bilha pillegesh aviv vayyishma yisrael vayyihyu bene yaakov shenem asar. ribbi elazar amar, vayhi bishkon yisrael baaretz hahi, deha lea verachel mitu, venatla beta man denatil.

Vechi salka datach diruven azil veshachiv bahadah devilha. ella, kol yoma delea verachel shechinta sharyay alayyhu. vehasheta demitu, shechinta la itperashat min beta, vesharya beveta bemishkena devilha. veaf al gav dishchinta baya lenatla beta kedka yaot, ilmale yaakov la ishtakkach beziuuga dechar venukeva, la sharya shechinta beitgalleya beveta. veal da kayyma shechinta bemashkena devilha. veata reuven uvegin dechama devilha yarta atra deimmeh, azal uvilbel arsa. veal dekayyma shechinta alah, ketiv beh vayyishkav et bilha.

Rabbi yesa amar, denaim al hahu arsa vela chayyish likara dishchinta. uvegin kach la itpegim mechushebana deshivtin veata kera veavid chushebna. begin kach ketiv, bechor yaakov reuven. veihu avid kera resha dechol shivtin.

Rabbi yehuda patach veamar, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vegomer, kol archoy dekudesha berich hu kullehu yesharim vearchoy keshot, uveni alma la yadin vela mashgichin al ma inun kayymin. veal da vetzaddikim yelchu vam, begin deinun yadin archoy dekudesha berich hu umishtaddele beorayyta. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, ihu yada veazil behu dela sate limina velismala.

Ufoshim yikkashlu vam, illen inun chayyayvin dela mishtaddele beorayyta, vela mistakkelan bearchoy dekudesha berich hu vela yadin lean orche azlin. uvegin dela yade leistakkela velo mishtaddele beorayyta, inun kashle behu beinun archoy behay alma uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, kol bar nash deishtaddal beorayyta, kad nafik mehay alma nishmateh salka beinun archin ushevilin (deinnun beorayyta) deorayyta. veinun archin ushevilin deorayyta yedian inun, veinun deyade archoy deorayyta behay alma yahachun behu behahu alma kad yifkun mehay alma.

Vei la ishtaddalu beorayyta behay alma vela yadin archin ushevilin, kad yifkun mehay alma la yindeun lemehach beinun archin ushevilin vechashlin behon. keden yehach bearchin ochoranin delav inun archin deorayyta, veyitarun leh bechamma dinin veitannash behu.

Uman deishtaddal beorayyta ma ketiv, (Mishlei 6:22) beshachbecha tishmor alecha vahakitzota hi tesichecha. beshachbecha bekivra, orayyta titztzor alecha middina dehahu alma. vehekitzota, kad kudesha berich hu yitar ruchin venishmatin leachayyay metayay keden hi tesichecha, hi tehe sannegorya al gufa, begin dikumun inun gufin deishtaddelu veorayyta kiddeka yaot. veillen inun dikumun bekadmita lechayye alma, kema deat amer, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim misheni admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam vegomer. veillen inun lechayye olam, begin deitasseku bechayye olam deihi orayyta.

Veta chaze, kol inun deishtaddelu beorayyta, hahu gufa yitkayyaym veorayyta tagin aleh. may tama, begin divhahi shata yitar kudesha berich hu chad rucha dechalil mearba ruchin, vehahu rucha dechalil mearba ruchin, izdamman lechol inun deishtaddelu beorayyta laachayay lon behay rucha begin deyitkayaym lealmin.

Vei tema, ha ketiv (Yechezkel 37:9) mearba ruchot boi haruach, ammay la itkayymu, deha kullehu mitu kemillekadmin. ta chaze, hahu zimna deokim kudesha berich hu al yeda dichezkel inun metayay, hahu (zimne deata) rucha af al gav dehava mearba ruchayyay, la nachit lekayyma lon bekiyyuma, ella leachazaa dezammin kudesha berich hu laachayay metayay behahu gavvna ulekayyma lon berucha
350: Deitkelil behay gavvna. veaf al gav deahadaru garmin behahi shata kema dehava. kudesha berich hu baa leachazaa lechol alma deihu zammin laachayay metayay (45 ketiv, 0 yichyu metecha nevelati yekumun. al da hahu rucha dezammin lenachta behu betzaddikaya) (nusach acher veal da hahu rucha dezammin lenachta behu betzaddikaya. ma ketiv mearba ruchot bae haruach, rucha deitkelilat bearba), begin dekudesha berich hu zammin lekayyma lehu kiyyuma shelim bealma kedka yeut. veinun deishtaddelu beorayyta behay alma, hi kayyma aleh devar nash veitavidat sannigorya kamme dekudesha berich hu.

Ribbi shimon amar, kol inun millin deorayyta vechol hahi orayyta deishtaddal bah bar nash behay alma, inun millin vehahi orayyta kayyma kamme kudesha berich hu vaamarat kameh vehi arimat kalin vela ishtakkachat. ulehahu zimna ihi tasiach vetema kefum deitdabbak bar nash veishtedal behay alma, veal da inun yekumun bekiyyuma shelim lechayye alma kedkaamaran. uvegin kach (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam.

Rabbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Shmuel 1 2:22) veeli zaken meod veshama et kol asher yaasun banav lechol yisrael veet asher yishkevun et hannashim hatztzovot petach ohel moed. vechi salka datach dechohane Adonai deyaavdun avidta da. veha mikkadmat dena ittemar uferishat orayyta hahu chova dilhon dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 2:17) ki niatzu haanashim et minchat Adonai. uchetiv umishpat hakkohanim meet haam kol ish zoveach zevach vegomer. uchetiv gam beterem yaktirun et hachelev uva naar hakkohen veamar laish hazzoveach tena litzlot lakkohen vegomer. uchetiv veamar lo ki atta titten veim lo lakachti bechazka. veal da vattehi chattat hannearim gedola meod vegomer. vechol da la havu natlin ella meinun chulakin dehavu lehu lechahane lemechal minneh, veal dehava kalil karbana beenayyhu itanashu. vehacha amar et asher yishkevun et hannashim hatztzovot.

(Ella) chas veshalom dehavu avdu avera da, kol shekken beatra kaddisha hahu, dela yekumun kol yisrael veyiktelun lehon. ella begin dehavu meakkeve lon leoola lemakdesha, umachan bidehon dela leoola lemitzle tzelota ad dekurebanaya itavidu begin deinun la mayytin karbanin lemetal chulaka minnayyhu, uvegin kach meakkevin lon. uvegin kach inun nashim havu baan minnayyhu leaola tamman. veal da ketiv et asher yishkevun et hannashim, dimakkeve lon kidkaamaran.

Kegavvna da vayyishkav et bilha. chas veshalom deihu shachav immah, ella begin deakkav lah leshammasha baavoy shimmusha demitzva, veda hu bilbula dearsa. veavad lokovel shechinta avidta da, debchol atar deshimmusha demitzva ishtakkach, shechinta sharya al hahu atar veishtakkach tamman. uman degarim leakkava shimmusha demitzva garim deyistallak shechinta mealma. veal da ketiv (Bereshit 49:4) ki alita mishkeve avicha az chillalta yetzui ala. uvegin da ketiv, vayyishkav et bilha pilegesh aviv vayyishma yisrael vayyihyu beni yaakov shenem asar. kullehu havu beminyayna vela gara mizzechuta dilhon kelum.

Ribbi elazar amar, may taama bekadmita yisrael ulevatar yaakov. dichtiv, vayyishma yisrael vayyihyu bene yaakov shenem asar. ella kad ata reuven uvilbel hahu arsa amar uma teresar shivtin havu leh leabba lekayyma bealma vela yattir, vehasheta bae leolada benin dilma anan pegimin deihu bae leolada ochoranin kemillekadmin. miyyad bilbel hahu arsa, veitakkav hahu shimmusha. keillu avad kelana legabbe shechinta desharya al hahu arsa. veal da ketiv vayyishma yisrael, deha bishma da istallak go teresar deitkasyayn deinun teresar nahari afarsemona dachya.
Vayyihyu beni yaakov shenem asar, illen teresar shivtin dishchinta ittakkanat behu. uman inun, illen deorayyta ahadarat veavid lon chushebna
351: Kemillekaddemin. kullehu kaddishin, kullehu itchazyayn legabbe shechinta leistakkala bikdusha demarehon. deillu avad hahu ovada la yete reuven beminyayna.

Veim kol da itanash deitnetil bechorateh minneh veityehiv leyosef kema deat amer, (divrei hayamim 1 Adonai:1) uvene reuven bechor yisrael ki hu habbechor uvechallelo yetzue aviv nittena bechorato leyosef. ta chaze, (Daniel 2:20) lehve sheme di elaha mevarach min alma vead alma di kol mabedohi keshot vearchateh din, vechol ma deihu avid kolla ihu bechachmeta illaa.

Ta chaze, kamma garim ovada devar nash, deha kol may (man) deihu avid, kolla itreshim vekayyma kamme dekudesha berich hu. deha yaakov beshata deal legabbah delea, kol hahu lelya reuteh velibbeh hava berachel, dechashiv derachel ihi. umehahu shimmusha vetippa kadmaa umehahu reuta itavarat lea veukemuha. deha ilmale deyaakov la yada la yistallik reuven bechushebana. veal da la istallak bishma yedia ella shemeh setam reuven.

Veim kol da ahadar ovada leatreh, kema dehahu reuta kadmaa itavidat berachel, hahu reuta ithaddarat bah. deha bechorateh ahadarat leyosef buchera derachel, atar diruta havat berachel vecholla salik beatreh. begin dechol ovadoy dekudesha berich hu kullehu keshot uzechu.

Ribbi chizkiyya ashkecheh yoma chad lerabbi yose dehava mistemit safsina go kitre denura vehava salik kittora ditnana leela. amar leh, illu kittura ditnana dekarbana dehava salik al gabbe madbecha hava salik tadir ki hay gavvna, la sharya rugeza bealma veyisrael la itgeli meal ara.

Patach rabbi yose veamar, (Shir HaShirim 3:6) mi zot ola min hammidbar ketimrot ashan mekutteret mor ulevona mikkol avkat rochel. mi zot ola. ta chaze, bezimna dehavu yisrael azle bemadbera, shechinta azla kammayyhu veinhu havu azle avatrah. dichtiv, (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan lanchotam hadderech velayla beammud esh lehair lahem vegomer. uvegin kach ketiv, (yirmeya 2) ko amar Adonai zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat kelulotayich lechtech acharay bammidbar vegomer.

Ushechinta havat azla vechullehu anane yekar bahadah. vechad hava shechinta natla, havu natlin. kema dichtiv, (Shemot 40:36) uvehealot heanan meal haohel veachare chen yisseu beni yisrael vegomer. vechad ihi salka hahu anana salka ad leela, vechol bene alma chaman veshaale veamre, mi zot ola min hammidbar ketimrot ashan.

Hahu anana dishchinta itchazya ashan, may taama ihi ashan. begin denura deadlik avraham veyitzchak bereh hava achid bah vela aade minah. vechad itachdat hahu nura begavvav hava salik anana (nusach acher tenana).
Veim kol da, mekutteret mor ulevona. may mekutteret, mitkatra bitren sitrin ochoranin, anana deavraham limina, anana deyitzchak lismala. mikkol avkat rochel, da yaakov.

Davar acher da yosef hatztzaddik, begin daarona deyosef hava azil legabbeh, ammay rochel, begin dehava rachil laachoy legabbeh deavoy. davar acher ammay rochel, ella ma chenvani da ketire dekusetre veavke defuleme kullehu bideh. hachi name yosef, ihu kiyyuma deorayyta begin deihu kiyyem lah, begin dechol pikkude orayyta mitkashsheran bintiru divrit kaddisha.

Veal da shechinta mitkattera beavraham yitzchak veyaakov veyosef, kechada inun vediukena chada lehu. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 37:2) elle toldot yaakov yosef. uvegin kach mikkol avkat rochel, begin demeatar denahara denagid venafik ishtakyay kolla unehiru kol anpin.

Veta chaze, kad havu yisrael beara vehavu makrivin karbanin, kullehu havu mitkarvin legabbe kudesha berich hu kedka yaot, vechad karbana itavid utenana salik beorach meshar, keden havu yade ditnana demadbecha adlik
352: Botzina deitchazzeya leadlaka, vechol anpin nehirin uvotzinin dalkin.

Umiyyoma deitchariv be makdesha let lach yoma veyoma delet beh zeimu verugeza. kema deat amer, (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom, veitparash chedva meela umittatta. veyisrael azlin begaluta veinun birshu detaavavn ochoranin. ucheden itkeyyaym kera dichtiv, (Devarim 28:36) veavadta sham elohim acherim.
Vechol da lamma, begin dichtiv, (Devarim 28:47) tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav merov kol. may merov kol. hacha merov kol, vehatam bechoser kol.

Ad deyitar kudesha berich hu veyifrok lon mibbeni ammaya, kema deat amer, (Devarim 30:3) veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha verichamcha veshav vekibbetzcha mikkol haammim asher hefitzcha Adonai elohecha shamma. uchetiv im yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim mishsham yekabbetzcha vegomer:

Veelle toldot esav hu edom. ta chaze, bechayye yitzchak la itmannun benoy deesav kema deitmannun benoy deyaakov, deha ad la mit yitzchak itmannun. aval beesav ma ketiv vayyigva yitzchak vayyamat vayyeasef el ammav zaken useva yamim vayyikberu oto esav veyaakov banav. batreh ma ketiv veelle toldot esav hu edom. may tama, begin deha bechulakeh uveachsanteh veadveh lav ihu, ella yaakov uvenoy. uvegin kach yaakov uvenoy inun chulakeh dekudesha berich hu vealin bechushebna. aval esav delav ihu bechulaka devistar dimhemnuta, avid chushebneh levatar demit yitzchak, veitperash chulakeh leatar ochora.

Ta chaze, levatar demit yitzchak, veesav itparash lesitreh, ma ketiv vayikkach esav et nashav vegomer mippene yaakov achiv. deshavak leh leyaakov keren verevach shibuda demitzrayim, veara. vezabbin leh chulakeh min mearta dechafelta, veazal leh min ara umin mehemnuta umechulakeh, deazal leh mikkolla.

Ta chaze, kamma hava chulakeh deyaakov tava becholla. begin dela ishtaar esav bahadeh veitperash minneh veazal leh lechulakeh uleadveh, veishtaar yaakov achid beachsanat avoy uveachsanat avhatoy. veal da vayyelech el eretz mippene yaakov achiv. may mippene yaakov achiv. dela baa chulakeh veachsanteh veadva dimhemnuta dileh. zakkaa chulakeh deyaakov aleh ketiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato:

Veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom lifne melach melech livne yisrael. rabbi yesa patach veamar, (Ovadya 1:2) hinne katan netatticha baggoyim bazuy atta meod. ta chaze, kad avad kudesha berich hu alma, ufalag ara leshiva techume peligin lokovel shivin ravrevin memannan, vekudesha berich hu palig lon leshivin amin kol chad vechad kedka chaze leh, kema deat amer, (dabeham lak) behanechel elyon goyim behaferido bene adam yatzev gevulot amim.

Umikkullehu ravrevan memannan deitmasru lishar amin la it behu bazuy kammeh kimmanna deesav. may taama, begin desitra deesav sitra mesaava ihu, vesitra dimsaava ihu kelana kammeh kudesha berich hu. meinun dargin zeirin devatar rechaya serikta dekostere sumeke ka atya, veal da hinne katan netatticha baggoyim, bazuy atta meod. dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:14) al gechoncha telech veafar tochal kol yeme chayyecha. meod, kema deat amer arur atta mikkol habbehema umikkol chayyat hassade.

Ta chaze, bedargin tattain it dargin al dargin, kullehu meshanyayn da min da, vechullehu dargin kaftirin illen, ukeshirin illen beillen, umalchu itparash da min da, umalchu itkashshar bemalchu. da ayyil, veda salik, achidan bekishra chada.
Hahu kishra mishchata chada leh, utelat kishrin lehahi mishchata. bechol kishra vekishra chad ittera, uvechol ittera veittera chad kafsora
Veitmanna beittura dilela, veitmanna venachit letatta, ad deitkashsheru beh kochvaya umazzale. kol chad vechad itperash beh chad
353: Kochava vechad mazzala, vechol kochvaya zeminin inun beinun dargin dilela. veal da kol darga vedarga itattar beatrin yedian kedka chaze.

Vechad mitparshan dargin ishtakkach kittura defusetaka, ad deitkashshera besitra deitchaze lon, vesitre dedarge mesaave deinun bistar semala kullehu mitparshan lechamma archin ushevilin missitre gevuran sumekan. uvegin kach talyayn gevuran letatta leelef alfin veribbo rivvan, veal da hinne katan netatticha baggoyim bazuy atta meod kidkaamaran.

Ta chaze, veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom. beeretz, besitra dedarga dileh deihu darga deesav. dichtiv esav hu edom, vechullehu kaatu missitra deruach mesaava. lifne melach melech livne yisrael, begin deinun dargin dekayyaymin be tare letatta kadmay. uvegin kach amar yaakov, yaavar na adoni lifne avdo. begin dargin dileh kadmain inun leoola. uvegin chach lifne melach melech livni yisrael. dead kean la mata zimna demalchu shemaya leshaltaa uleitachada bivni yisrael. uvegin kach amar yaavar na adoni lifni avdo.

Vechad shelimu illen dargin bekadmita, levatar itar malchu shemaya leshaltaa al tattae. vechad shara, shara bizira dechol shivtin deihu binyamin. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 68:28) sham binyamin tzair rodem vegomer. uveh share leatara malchuta, levatar ata malchuta beatreh veitkeyyaym bahadeh dela taade lealmin.

Ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 45:1) veatta shema yaakov avdi veyisrael bacharti vo. ko amar Adonai osecha veyotzercha mibbeten yaazrekka al tira avdi yaakov vishurun bacharti vo. ta chaze, kamma avtach lon kudesha berich hu leyisrael bechamma atar (davar acher 33 begin) lemizke lehu lealma deate, deha la itrae lechulakeh lechol am velishan bar leyisrael bilchodoy. uvegin kach yahav lon orayyta dikshot. lemizke bah uleminda archoy dekudesha berich hu begin deyirtun ara kaddisha. dechol man dezache behay ara kaddisha, it leh chulaka lealma deate. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz. veha ittemar.
Telat dargin hacha, bekadmita yaakov, ulevatar yisrael, ulevatar yeshurun. ta chaze, yaakov ha ukemuha. yisrael uf hachi name. veaf al gav dedargin inun chad.

Yeshurun, ammay ikrun yisrael bishma da. ella yisrael vishurun kolla chad. yeshurun, kema deat amer, (Iyov 33:27) yashor al anashim, begin denatil shura lehay sitra ulehay sitra, uvegin inun teren shurin ikre yeshurun, veda hu yisrael.
Yisrael al denatil revu vetukefa mikkolla. yisrael (sefer acher yshevarevan) al inun chulake teren sitrin terin shurin kedka amaran, vecholla chad.

Veinun shemahan kullehu salke lechad. yaakov avdi, zimnin deihu eved keavda deit leh pikkuda demareh ulemebad reuteh. vechen yisrael bacharti vo, leashraa aleh, vecholla beraza illaa ihu. ketiv, (Yeshayahu 43:1) boraacha yaakov veyotzercha yisrael, uchetiv ko amar Adonai osecha, kol illen dargin salkin lechad veha ittemar, bore, yotzer. ose. vechullehu dargin illen al illen vechullehu chad.

Zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael dekudesha berich hu itrae behu mikkol amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, begin devchullehu ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:15) hevel hemma maase tatuim beet pekuddatam yovedu, beshata dekudesha berich hu zammin levaara lon min alma, veyishtaar hu bilchodoy kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 2:11) venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 41:14) al tiri tolaat yaakov mete yisrael ani azartich neum Adonai vegoalech kedosh yisrael. ta chaze, kol amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot dealma, kudesha berich hu yahav lon limmannan shaltanin yediin kema deittemar. vechullehu azle batar elahahon, kema dichtiv, (Micha 4:Adonai) ki chol haammim yelchu ish beshem elohav. vechullehu oshdin damin umaggichin kerava gazlin kappechin umenaafin, veitarve
354: Bechamma ovadin levish, veittakkafu bechelhon leavasha.
Veyisrael let lon tukefa vechela lenatzchaa lon bar befumehon, ketolata da delet lah tukefa vechela ella befuma, uvefuma mitbar kolla, veal da ikrun yisrael tolaat.

Tu al tiri tolaat yaakov, ma tolaat let livriya dealma kehay tolaat demeshi desistera, deminnah nafke kol levushe yekar tistere demalchin, levatar zara zarin umit, ulevatar mehahu zara deishtaar minneh itkeyyaym kemillekaddemin veha ihu bekiyyuma. kach yisrael inun kehay tolaat. deaf al gav demetin, yithadderun veyitkayyeymun bealma kemillekaddemin.

Veha ittemar (davar acher 33 dichtiv) (Yirmeyahu 18:6) ki kachomer beyad hayyotzer ken attem beyadi bet yisrael. may kachomer. ela da hu chomer dehahu zechuchit, deaf al gav deittavar ittakkan veit leh takkana kemillekaddemin.

Mete yisrael, da ilana dechayye, divgin deyisrael inun itdabbaku beilana dechayye, begin kach yehe chayyin lehon vikumun meafra veyitkayyeymun bealma, vihon leam chad lemiflach leh lekudesha berich hu. kema deat amer (Tzefanya 3:9) likro kullam beshem Adonai leavdo shechem echad.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yitzchak havu azle bearcha, umata zimna dikriat shema, vekam rabbi elazar vekara keriat shema vetzalle tzeloteh. levatar amar leh ribbi yitzchak, veha taninan dead la yippuk bar nash learcha ibbae leh lenatla reshu mimmareh uletzalle tzeloteh.

Amar leh, begin dechad nafikna la hava zeman tzelota vela mata zimna dikriat shema, hasheta deshimsha nahir tzallena. aval ad la nafakna learcha baina bauta minneh veimlachna beh, aval tzelota da la tzallena.

Deha ana ishtaddalna beorayyta mippalgut lelya, vechad ata tzafra ad kean la hava idna letzalle tzelota. begin dehahi shata dekadruta detzafra ishtakkach, itteta mishtaaya bevaalah, veinun beraza kechada, devaya ihi lemehach lemishkena beulemtaha deyatve bahadah. uvegin kach la bae leh levar nash lemifsak milayyhu demitchabberan kechada uleaola milla achara benayyhu.

Vehasheta denahir shimsha hu iddan tzelota letzallaa, kema deukemuha. dichtiv, (Tehillim 72:5) yiraucha im shamesh. mahu im shamesh, lenatra nehora deshimsha bahadan leanhara lah, deha yerae bahade shimsha itzterich vela leafrasha lon. vechad la nahir yemama lav hu yerae bahade shimsha, utzericha lechabbera lon kechada. veda hu im shamesh.

Azle, kad matu chad be chakal, yatvu. zakfu enayyhu vechama leh letura dehavu salku berumeh beriyyayn meshanyayn, dachil ribbi yitzchak, amar leh ribbi elazar ammay dechilat. amar leh chamena dehay tura ihu takkif, vechamena illen beriyyayn deinun meshanyayn vedachilna dela yekatregu lon, amar leh man dedachil mechetoy devideh it leh lemidchal. ta chaze, lav illen meinun beriyyayn takkifin dehavu mishtakkechin beturaya.

Patach veamar. veelle bene tzivon veayya vaana vegomer hu ana asher matza et hayyemim vegomer, hay kera ukemuha, aval ta chaze, lav illen inun dichtiv behu (Devarim 2:12) haemim lefanim yashvu vah vegomer uvene esav yirashum vegomer.

Aval illen dekaamar kera asher matza et hayyemim bammidbar, yemim ketiv. illen havu beriyyayn meshanyayn. dechad hava ittarach kayin meal appe ara kedichtiv, (Bereshit 4:14) hen gerashta oti hayyom meal pene haadama umippanycha essater, uchetiv vayyeshev beeretz nod veukemuha.

Mibbene benoy besitra (Vayikra 76 amud bet) deruchin veilulin umazzikin veillen kayymu, deha kad baa leitkaddesha yoma deshabbatta, ittavrun mehahu sitra ruchin kayymin tesirin (nusach acher tehirin) bela gufa. veilen lav inun miyyoma deshabbatta vela miyyoma shetitaa, veishtaaru illen teren yomin behu bisfeka, uvegin kach la itkayymu la
355: Veazlu veitpashshetu behahu sitra dekayin veiglimu behahu sitra vela itgelimu leitkayyma veikrun yemim chaser, dela itkayymu la beyoma da vela beyoma da, veitchazun livne nasha. veihu ashkach lon veolfe leh leayytaa mamzerin lealma. veinun azle bene turaya vekayymin begufa zimna chada beyoma, ulevatar mitpashte minneh.
Ta chaze, ana da ihu mamzera hava, deata tzivon al immeh veolid mamzera, veda ata missitra deruach mesaava deitdabbak beh. uvegin kach ashkach lon vehavu olfe leh kol zinin distar mesaava begin da.

Veta chaze, illen inun vechamma ochoranin mitparshan illen meillen, kullehu atyayn mehahu sitra veazle bemadbera veitchazun tamman. begin demadbera atar charuv veihu be motava dilhon. veim kol da, kol var nash deazil beorchoy dekudesha berich hu vedachil leh lekudesha berich hu la mistafe minnayyhu. azlu veoolu betura.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, kegavvna da kol inun turin charuvin atar be motava dilhon. amar leh, hachi hu, vechol inun demishtaddelu beorayyta alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 121:7-8) Adonai yishmarcha mikkol ra yishmor et nafshecha Adonai yishmar tzetcha uvoecha meatta vead olam.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (sham 111) haleluya ode Adonai bechol levav besod yesharim veeda, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, david malka kol yomoy hava mishtaddal befulechana dekudesha berich hu, vehava kam befalgut lelya umeshabbach umode beshirin vetushebchan, begin leittakkana ducheteh bemalchu dilela.

Dechad itar ruach tzafon befalgut lelya, hava yada dekudesha berich hu behahi shata yitar beginta deeden leishtashea im tzaddikayyay, veihu hava kam behahi shata veitgabbar beshirin vetushebchan ad desalik tzafra.

Begin dechad kudesha berich hu ishtakkach beginta deeden, ha okimna deihu vechol tzaddikayyay divginta kullehu tzayytin lekaleh. kedichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:13) chaverim makshivim lekolech hashemiini. vela od, ella dechuta dechesed mashich aleh bimama kema deittemar. dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi. velo od, ella deinun millin deorayyta deihu amar, kullehu salkin umitatterin kamme kudesha berich hu. uvegin kach david malka hava mishtaddel belelya befulechana demareh.

Ta chaze, haleluyah, bechol inun shirin vetushebchan dekaamar david, ha taninan dilela mikkullehon hu haleluyah veukemuha. may tama begin dechalil shema ushevacha kachada. may shema ushevacha. shema da (1) 15. shevacha man ihu, ella da keneset yisrael deihu (hillel 55 65 shehu adonay) metaknna shevacha tadir lekudesha berich hu, vela ishtakkechat. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 83:2) elohim al domi lach al techorash veal tishkot el. begin desiddura deshvacha ihi mesadderat umeshabbachat tadir legabbeh. uvegin kach shema ushevacha kachada.
Ode Adonai bechol levav, kema deukemuha beyetzer hattov uveyetzer hara, begin deinun mishtakkeche tadir legabbeh devar nash, kema deat amer, (Devarim 6) bechol levavcha veukemuha.

Besod yesharim (veeda), illen inun yisrael dechol dargin behu mitatteran kahane velevae, tzaddike vachaside, yesharim. veeda, kema deat amer (Tehillim 82:1) nitztzav baadat el. veinun raza dekudesha berich hu itattar behu.

Uvegin kach bae var nash leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu tadir, begin deihu itrae beshirin vetushebchan, uman deyada leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu kedka yeut, kudesha berich hu kabbil tzeloteh vesheziv leh. hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 91:14) asaggevehu ki yada shemi vegomer orech yamim vegomer.

Patach rabbi yose veamar, (Tehillim 32:7) atta seter li mitztzar titzreni rani fallet tesovveni sella. atta seter li, da kudesha berich hu deihu sitra umagen levar nash deazil bearche deorayyta, veihu istattar betzilla degadfoy dela yachlin leavasha leh. mitztzar titzreni, meela umittatta, leela it leh levar nash mare devavu, letatta uf hachi name. uman ihu, da yetzer hara,
356: Deihu tzar leela vetzar letatta. veilmale yetzer hara, la ishtakkach mare devavu levar nash bealma. begin kach mitztzar titzreni.

Rane fallet tesovveni sela, yesovveni sela mibbae leh, may tesovveni. illen inun shirin deit behu dargin lehatztzala, tesovveni behu leshezava li bearcha. vehay kera ihu kesidra veihu lemafrea, mehay gisa umehay gisa.

Ta chaze, beillen shirin vetushebchan dekaamar david it behon razin umillin illain beraze dechachmeta, begin dechullehu beruach kudesha itamaru. dehava shara ruach kudesha aleh dedavid, vehava amar shirata. uvegin kach kullehu beraze dechachmeta itamaru.

Patach rabbi elazar veamar, (Tehillim 118:13) dacho dechitani linpol vaAdonai azarani, dacho dechitani, dacho dachuni mibbae leh, may dacho dechitani. ella da sitra ochora dedachyay leh levar nash tadir, uvae ledachyay leh uleastaa leh meim kudesha berich hu. veda hu yetzer hara deishtakkach legabbeh debar nash tadir. ulekovleh ahadar david veamar dacho dechitani linpol. begin deihu hava ishtaddal legabbeh bechol inun aktin leastaa leh meim kudesha berich hu. vealeh amar david dacho dechitani linpol baggehinnam. vaAdonai azarani dela itmassarna bidach. veal da it leh levar nash leizdahara minneh, begin dela yishlot aleh. vekudesha berich hu keden natir leh bechol archoy. dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:23) az telech lavetach darkecha veraglecha lo tiggof (Mishlei 4:12) belechtecha lo yetzar tzaadecha veim tarutz lo tikkashel. uchetiv, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech veor ad nechon hayyom.

Amar rabbi yehuda zakkain inun yisrael dekudesha berich hu natir lon bealma den uvealma deate. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. (ad kan parashat vayyishlach)
357: Izdamman immeh devar nash. veal da ihu melech zaken uchesil.

Asher lo yada lehizzaher od, lehazehir la ketiv, ella lehizzaher, begin deihu chesil. vealeh amar shelomo alav hashalom (Kohelet 2:14) vehakkesil bachoshech holech. deha messusita dechoshech ka atya velet leh nehora lealmin.

Ribbi shimon amar, ta chaze, ketiv tov yeled misken vechacham. man yeled misken, ha ukemuha veittemar deihu yetzer tov. aval tov yeled, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 37:25) naar hayiti gam zakanti. veda hu naar deihu yeled misken delet leh miggarmeh kelum. veammay ikre naar, begin deit leh chadtu desihara demitchaddesha tadir, vetadir ihu yeled misken kema deamran. vechacham, begin dechachma sharya beh.

Mimmelecha zaken, da hu yetzer hara kema deittemar. deha min yoma dehava la nafak mimmesaavuteh lealmin, veihu chesil. dechol archoy inun leorach bisha, veazil vesate livni nasha vela yada leizdahara. veihu ate im var nash betiskufin begin leastaa lon meorach tava leorach bisha.

Ta chaze, al da akdim im bar nash beyoma deityelid begin diyhemin leh. deha kad ate yetzer tov la yachil var nash limhemna leh vedame aleh kematula. kegavvna da taninan, man hu rasha arum, da hu man deakdim leatana milloy lekamme dayyna ad la yete chavreh mare dedina. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 18:17) tzaddik harishon berivo vegomer.

Kegavvna da (hu nusach acher hay) rasha arum, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 3:1) vehannachash haya arum. vehu akdim veshare immeh devar nash ad la yete chavreh leashraa aleh. uvegin deihu akdim veha atin taanateh immeh, kad ate chavreh deihu yetzer hattov, avish leh levar nash bahadeh vela yachil lezakfa resheh, keillu atin al kitfeh kol matolin dealma. begin hahu rasha arum deakdim immeh. veal da amar shelomo (Kohelet 9:16) vechachmat hammisken bezuya udevarav enam nishmaim, begin deha akdim ochora.

Veal da kol dayyne dekabbil mibbar nash milla ad la yete chavreh, keillu mekabbel aleh taavav ochora limhemnuta. ella (Mishlei 18:17) uva reehu vachakaro, veda hu orach devar nash zakkaa, deha var nash zakkaa da hu, dela hemin lehahu rasha arum deyetzer hara, ad deyete chavreh deihu yetzer tov. uvegin da bene nasha inun kashlin lealma deate.

Aval hahu zakkaa deihu dachil lemareh, kamma bishin savil behay alma begin dela yehemin vela yishtattaf behahu yetzer hara. vekudesha berich hu sheziv leh mikkullehu, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim la) rabbot raot tzaddik umikkullam yatztzilenu Adonai. rabbot raot latztzaddik la ketiv, ella tzaddik. begin dekudesha berich hu itrae beh. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu itrae behahu var nash vesheziv leh mikkolla behay alma uvealma deate, zakkaa chulakeh.

Ta chaze, kamma bishin avru aleh deyaakov, begin dela yitdabbak behahu yetzer hara veyitrechak mechulakeh. uvegin kach savil kamma onshin kamma bishin vela shakit. patach veamar, (Iyov 3:26) lo shalavti velo shakatti velo nachti vayyavo rogez. ta chaze, kamma bishin savlin tzaddikaya behay alma. bishin al bishin, keevin al keevin. begin lemizke lon lealma deate.

Yaakov kamma savil bishin al bishin tadir, kema deat amer lo shalavti, beveta delavan, vela yachilna leishtezava minneh. velo shakatti, meesav. mehahu tzaara detzier li hahu memanna dileh, ulevatar dechilu deesav. velo nachti, min dina umin shechem.

Vayyavo rogez, da rugeza veirbuveya deyosef deihu kashya mikkullehu, miggo rechimuta deyaakov legabbe deyosef deihu raza divrit, al bemitzrayim. begin dilvatar ketiv, (Shemot 6:Adonai) vaezkor et beriti, leishtakkacha shechinta (nusach acher shemesh) tamman bahadeh.
Vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan,
358: Ribbi yose patach, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad veen ish sam al lev veanshe chesed neesafim been mevin ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik. hatztzaddik avad, bezimna dekudesha berich hu ashgach bealma vela have alma kedka yeut, veizdamman dina lesharyay al alma. keden kudesha berich hu natil zakkaa deishtakkach benayyhu, begin deyishre dina al kullehu ochoranin, vela yishtakkach man deyagin alayyhu.

Deha kol zimna dezakkaa share bealma, dina la yachil leshaltaa al alma. menalan mimmoshe, dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:23) vayyomer lehashemidam lule moshe vechiro amad bapperetz lefanav vegomer. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu natil lezakkaa mibbenayyhu vesallik leh mealma, ucheden itpera vegave dileh. sofeh dikra, ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik. ad dela yete raa leshaltaa al alma neesaf hatztzaddik. (davar acher ki mippene haraa neesaf ad lo yishlot haraa bealma) davar acher ki mippene haraa, da yetzer hara.
Ta chaze, yaakov shelimu daavahan hava veihu kaim lekayyma begaluta. aval miggo deihu tzaddik itakkav dina dela shalta bealma. deha kol yome deyaakov la shara dina al alma, vechafna itbatlat.

Veuf hachi beyomoy deyosef deihu diukena deavoy (kevan deihu met miyyad). la shera galuta (dina al alma). begin deihu agin alayyhu kol yomoy, kevan deihu met, miyyad shara alayyhu galuta. kema deat amer (Shemot 1:14) vayyamat yosef vegomer, vesamich leh hava nitchakkema lo. uchetiv vaymararu et chayyehem baavoda kasha bechomer uvilvenim vegomer.
Kegavvna da bechol atar desharya zakkaa (al) bealma begineh kudesha berich hu yagin al alma, vechol zimna deihu kayyaym, dina la sharya al alma veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv, may megure aviv, kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 6:25) magor misaviv, dechol yomoy hava dachil vehava bidchilu: vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv. ribbi elazar amar, deitkashshar veyativ behahu atar deitachid bachoshech. eretz megure aviv dayyka, beeretz kenaan, itkashshar atra beatreh. megure aviv, da dina kashya. beeretz megure aviv, kema deittemar hahu dina rafya deihi eretz, deitachid min dina kashya uveh ityashshev yaakov veitachid beh, (vehahi eretz ihi aspaklarya dela nahara):

Elle toldot yaakov yosef vegomer, batar deityashshav yosef beyaakov veizdavvavg shimsha besihara, keden shara lemebad toldot, uman ihu deavid toldot, ahadar veamar yosef, deha hahu nahar denagid venafik ihu avid toldot begin dela paskin memoy lealmin, veihu avid toldot behay eretz uminneh nafkin toldot lealma.
Deha shimsha af al gav deitkarav besihara la avid ibbin bar hahu darga deikre tzaddik, veyosef ihu darga deyaakov lemebad ibbin velafaka toladin lealma, uvegin kach ketiv elle toldot yaakov yosef.

Elle toldot yaakov yosef, kol man dehava mistakkel bediukena deyosef hava amar deda hu diukena deyaakov. ta chaze, divchullehu bene yaakov la ketiv elle toldot yaakov reuven, bar yosef, dediukenih dame lediukena deavoy.

Ben sheva esre shana. amar ribbi abba, ramaz leh kudesha berich hu, deha kad itavid minneh yosef ben sheva esre shenin hava. vechol inun yomin deishtaaru dela chama leh leyosef hava bache al inun sheva esre shenin. uchemma dehava bache aleh, kudesha berich hu yahav leh sheva esre shenin ochoranin deitkayyem beara demitzrayim bechedu bikara uvishlimu decholla. bereh yosef hava malka, vechol benoy kammeh havu, inun sheva esre shenin havu chayyin legabbeh. uvegin kach ben sheva esre shana hava ihu, kad itavid minneh.
Ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Iyov la) lachen anshe levav shimu li chalila lael mersha veshadday meavel. ki foal
359: Adam yeshallem lo ucheorach ish yamtziennu. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, avad leh al dina, veal dina itkayyaym. vechol ovadin dealma inun kayymin bedina. bar dekudesha berich hu begin lekayyma alma vela yitavid, paris aleh rachame, veinun rachame meakkeve ledina dela yishtetze alma, veal rachame itnahig alma veitkeyyaym beginih.

Vei tema dekudesha berich hu avid dina bevar nash bela dina. ha ittemar, dechad dina sharya aleh devar nash kad ihu zakkaa. begin rechimuta dekudesha berich hu beh ihi, kema deittemar. deha kudesha berich hu rachim aleh birchimu lekarva leh legabbeh, metabbar gufa begin leshaltaa nishmata, ucheden itkeriv bar nash legabbeh birchimu kedka yeut. venishmata shalta vegufa itchallash.

Uvaya gufa chulesha venafsha takkifa deittakkaf bitkifu, ucheden ihu rechima dekudesha berich hu. kema daamru chavrayay, yahav kudesha berich hu latztzaddik tzaara bealma den, begin lemizke leh lealma deate.

Vechad nishmata chalsha vegufa takifa, ihu saneh dekudesha berich hu dela itrae beh, la yahiv leh tzaara behay alma ella orchoy mittaknan vehu bishlimu yattir. begin dei avad tzedaka o tivu kudesha berich hu meshallem leh agreh behay alma vela yeheve leh chulak behahu alma. veda hu detirgem uneklus (Devarim 7:10) umeshallem lesonav vegomer, umeshallem lesanohi tavvavn deinun vegomer (ihu). uvegin kach hahu zakkaa deitbar tadir ihu rechima dekudesha berich hu, vehanne mile kad badak vela ashkach chova bideh deitannash aleh.

Hacha it leistakkala bechamma sitrin. chad, deha chaminan dishchinta la sharya beatar atzivu ella beatar deit beh chedva. i chedva let beh, la sharya shechinta behahu atar. kema deat amer, (Melachim 2 3:15) veatta kechu li menaggen vehaya chenaggen hamenaggen vattehi alav (14 Adonai) ruach elohim, deha shechinta vadday la sharya beatar atzivu. menalan miyyaakov. divgin dehava atziv aleh deyosef istalkat shechinta minneh, kevan deata leh chedva divsora deyosef miyyad vattechi ruach yaakov avihem. hacha behay zakkaa deittavar kevan deihu chalasha veittavar bemachovin, an hu chedva deha ihu baatzivu velet immeh chedva kelal.

Vechad deha chaminan kamma rechimin havu tzaddikaya kame kudesha berich hu vela ittavru bemarin vela bemachovin vela itchallash gufa dilhon lealmin. ammay lav illen keillen, deillen ittavru veillen kayyme begufayyhu kedka yeut.

Veim tomar deha illen dekayymu bekiyyuma kedka yeut, begin deinun tzaddike bene tzaddike inhu, kema deukemuha. veillen ochoranin tzaddike velav beni tzaddike, ha ka chamenan tzaddike bene tzaddike, deha avoy deden zakkaa bar zakkaa, veihu zakkaa. ammay ittavar gufeh bemachovin vechol yomoy betzaara.

Ella hacha raza ihu, deha kol ovadoy dekudesha berich hu bikshot uzechu (Iyov la) ki foal adam yeshallem lo ucheorach ish yamtziennu. ashkachna besifre kadmae raza chada, ulegabbeh raza ochora chad deihu teren, deha it zimnin desihara ihi bifgimu vesharya bedina veshimsha la ishtakkach gabba. uvechol zimna uvechol shata it lah leafaka nishmatin bivne nasha kema delakta bekadmita, vaafikat lon hasheta bezimna deihi kayyma bedina. hay man denakit lah behahu zimna leheve tadir bigriuta, umiskenuta azla legabbeh, veittavar tadir bedina kol yomoy devar nash ben chayyayva ben zakkaa. bar ditzlota batil kol gizre dinin veyachil lesalka bitzlota.

Vehahu zimna dekayyma hahu darga bishlimu, vehahu nahar denagid venafik ishtammash bah, keden hahu nishmata denafkat veitdabbekat beh behahu var nash, hahu bar nash ishtallim becholla beutera bivnin bishlimu degufa.
